Scott DesJarlais, the guy I am running against in TN-04, took two oaths.
The first was the Hippocratic oath, the doctor's promise to do no harm. The second was the congressional oath, the legislator's promise to serve the people of this district with honesty and conviction.
**He broke both.** Public records show he pressured a mistress (who was also his patient) to get an abortion. A direct, documented violation of the ethical boundary between physician and patient. Meanwhile, he spent 14 years voting to strip healthcare access from the very people who trusted him with their votes, calling the repeal of the Affordable Care Act his "number one priority."
_**After years of trying to tear down our healthcare system, has Scott DesJarlais offered a serious plan to make it better? No.**_
_**He collects a government paycheck, listens to whatever the "party lines" are and calls it leadership. Aug 1 | | | | | | | | | Scott DesJarlais, the guy I am running against in TN-04, took two oaths. The first was the Hippocratic oath, the doctor's promise to do no harm. The second was the congressional oath, the legislator's promise to serve the people of this district with honesty and conviction. He broke both. Public records show he pressured a mistress (who was also his patient) to get an abortion. A direct, documented violation of the ethical boundary between physician and patient. Meanwhile, he spent 14 years voting to strip healthcare access from the very people who trusted him with their votes, calling the repeal of the Affordable Care Act his "number one priority." After years of trying to tear down our healthcare system, has Scott DesJarlais offered a serious plan to make it better? No. He collects a government paycheck, listens to whatever the "party lines" are and calls it leadership. Tennessee deserves better. ! | | ---|---|--- Tennessee is only as strong as its most vulnerable neighbor and only as successful as the children we leave behind. That's why it's time to send career politicians like Scott DesJarlais into retirement, and usher the next generation of Congressmen that is not scared to fight for YOU. Desjarlais wore a pro-life rating like a badge of honor while operating by a completely different set of rules behind closed doors. He accepted the endorsements and cashed the checks... all while building a record that is the single greatest argument against ever giving him another term. This isn't personal. It's a pattern. A man who has spent his entire career saying one thing and doing another deserves exactly one thing in return: A pink slip from the people he was elected to serve.Let 's send someone to Washington who actually means what they say. Peter,

The Missouri primary is this Tuesday, August 4th. In just three days,

up one more time to help her win on Tuesday and reclaim her seat in

# Over 300,000 Electric Cut-Offs Pending Under Wes Moore.

# Wes Moore is focused on his own political power...but Maryland families need a governor who will keep their electric power on.
Dear friend, Never has the urgency of our need for your support been as clear as it is now. Wes Moore is a Democratic-Socialist-praising Democratic frontrunner to be president - but we can stop him here in Maryland with your help.

[](https://us.list-manage.com/17rzhOspdBL?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)

Today, _Wes Moore is building his national political profile which[AP News](https://us.list-manage.com/nXEdfB87iQX?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) is reporting clearly makes him a presidential contender by becoming the Chair of the National Governor's Association (NGA),_ which he then divisively is using to publicly lie claiming current federal interference the 2026 elections before they are even held.

And he is using his new position to push for a national "service program" for youth \- which he says will "save us as a society."1

But he can't even save someone here in Maryland from losing their electricity during the hot summer months.

It's simple. Wes Moore has a governance failure problem.

And this Monday, Wes Moore is calling legislators back to Annapolis to change Maryland’s redistricting rules and steal the voices of millions of Maryland voters. To advance his national ambitions, Wes Moore wants to make Maryland an 8-0 Democrat Representation in the U.S. House of Representatives.

Meanwhile, nearly 300,000 Maryland families are facing imminent electric shutoff while also facing another proposed BGE rate increase. Where is Wes? Traveling the country campaigning while offering an offensive $12.50 in assistance to ratepayers. This electric cut-off number is up from 115,000 electric cut offs last year, 100,000 cut-offs in 2024 and similar numbers in 2023.

Wes Moore's Maryland is potentially on track to have over 500,000 electric cut-offs before the end of his term. [Help me make it his only term.](https://us.list-manage.com/14ywuyzs9w6?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)

I will act to bring new power plants back online immediately and lower electric bills. My plan will bring closed power plants back online, expand LNG and bring online Small Modular Reactors that can efficiently power whole cities safely. SMRs are now even being considered in Pennsylvania and elsewhere, and real opportunities in this field are developing.

When we stop Wes Moore here we save both Maryland and the United States.

This is why I am asking for and need your help. [Please donate now](https://us.list-manage.com/Mwb1Kb2nTZK?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) \- any amount will help. You can also sign up to volunteer and [help us ballot chase](https://us.list-manage.com/KmhbSOAztR8?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) and win the swing votes needed to win the election.

For Maryland First,

Dan Cox
Republican Nominee for Governor of Maryland

P.S. Don't miss our [upcoming events](https://us.list-manage.com/Sfw5hOL6bry?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) as well. I'd love to see you there.

1\. Sound familiar? A school-to-work pipeline was first discussed as concerning in The Phyllis Schlafly Report, www. eagleforum.org, where Mrs. Schlafly detailed how it could create an "unholy alliance between big government and big corporations,” allowing bureaucrats to dictate national job placement.

Forty.
That's how many times low-propensity voters need to be contacted before they reliably show up on Election Day.
Not four. Not fourteen. **Forty.**
And contacting voters works best when it comes from a **familiar face.**
A stranger at the door doesn’t move the needle. If we want their vote, we’ve got to send someone they've seen before, someone who knows their name, someone who's already called, texted, or knocked on their door this month.
**[This is why Turning Point PAC's ballot-chasing model is built different.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTZ9AAwAAAAAAhiQZRxbCK5vq8rLDDHhEaDMPbLfxdObLqClSGYgpscwT-FSlxZ3TNl6W-Gx3ljntjQd080bShwei7ySfy6_G46W59OmCYc-4FNuxV28)**

We don't parachute volunteers in for a weekend blitz and call it a “ground game.”
Turning Point PAC embeds **trained, full-time ballot-chasers** in targeted precincts — the _same_ chasers, the _same_ doors, the _same_ voters — building real relationships week after week until their ballots are in the box.
That sustained presence is what low-propensity voters respond to (and how Charlie delivered all 5 swing states for President Trump in 2024).
**But turnout takes money**. That’s especially true in a midterm election where there’s no “Top of the ticket” generating natural enthusiasm and turnout. History shows many conservatives don’t vote in midterms unless someone makes them.
Early voting starts in less than 8 weeks. And the margin of our House majority — the margin that protects everything President Trump has built — will be decided by whether our people show up or stay home.
Forty contacts. A familiar face. Financed and sustained through November 3.
**That's the formula.[Your contribution DIRECTLY funds it.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTZ9AAwAAAAAAhiQZRxdxIpnvfPpOhceIV6YjylPJXiNQ5Zkl4yNFhOIFNBh1HZZLbJuDaUhD1Iq7FuFdh6RNgHvbA_8FDrC36I5mSI7-IRVC0HWhKk_)**

name: Jace Yarbrough
subject: Kneeling in prayer a few weeks ago, it hit me plainly.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Yarbrough for Congress
body:
I am fighting a great evil, and I cannot stop.

I am fighting a great evil, and I cannot stop.
| ["For we do not wrestle against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the cosmic powers over this present darkness, against the spiritual forces of evil."](https://trk.email.gopnewsnow.-68avE2IfVSQ)[Ephesians 6:12](https://trk.email.gopnewsnow.)
Friend,
Kneeling in prayer a few weeks ago, it hit me plainly. I am fighting a great evil, and I cannot stop.
I'm Jace Yarbrough - candidate for Congress.
[Three facts shape my life: I am a Christian, a husband, and a father of five.](https://trk.email.gopnewsnow.)
I also served in the Air Force, where I saw how Biden's COVID mandates had nothing to do with defending this country and everything to do with control. Twice, I stood up to my own chain of command to defend my faith.
It cost me, but it showed me who we're up against.
As a constitutional lawyer, I have fought for first responders forced to choose between their jobs and their conscience, and for minors targeted by abortion providers.
My wife Elizabeth and I even founded a Christian school because we refused to hand our kids over to a system that no longer shares our values.
America is in a battle between good and evil. Between freedom and godless communism, fighting to own our kids, our conscience, and our future.
I won't pretend I'm not afraid sometimes. But silence is how evil wins.
[I'm fighting to change this broken system once and for all. ](https://trk.email.gopnewsnow.)
[Sadly, nothing seems to cost more these days than running for public office. The honest truth is, I grew up with very little, and don't have bags of dark money like my opponent. ](https://trk.email.gopnewsnow._vitSVg)
[My filing deadline to take this message to DC hits Friday at midnight, and I need real strength to win this.](https://trk.email.gopnewsnow._m77MmVDKbw)
[Whatever you can give, $25, $50, $100, is an act of faith that this nation is still worth saving. Every hour we wait, the other side gets louder.](https://trk.email.gopnewsnow.)
You will be what makes my race. I thank you in advance and leave you with this:

I know who goes before us, and I know we were not made to be afraid.
Jesus Christ is our strength.
God bless America.
Jace YarbroughCandidate for Congress

I wrote last week about [friction](https://substack.com/redirect/a8f93ed3-b079-4c37-92ef-bfef31517844?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which is what you experience as a Democrat in the places I used to represent. It's impossible not to notice how dissatisfied small-town and rural western Pennsylvanians are with the national Democratic "brand."
But people like this live all over Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Michigan -- the traditional "blue wall" -- and also Ohio and Iowa, two places you might have gotten used to conceding, but which are essential for Senate control and which will become even more important after the 2030 [redistricting](https://substack.com/redirect/2c4eadb8-01d7-4f93-ab52-a6195af1db09?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
I think whoever we nominate in 2028 should have a credible claim to win these people back, but framing our choice that way means talking about our shortcomings, and I suspect Democrats will be reluctant to do that. So I'll do it here.
Consider the voters of Beaver County, Pennsylvania, in my old congressional district. At one time the county's Aliquippa Works was the largest integrated steel mill in the world. ([This](https://substack.com/redirect/103568e4-4b9d-4ce6-8aa4-91bd0efdad75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is a fascinating book about the local social and political history, with a focus on high school football.) The workers and their families all voted for Democrats. ...

| Turning Point PAC | | | | | [](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTZ9AAwAAAAAAhnV7iQ8qTY8HPAJRwiCk5dk1ChZW8WeuDyZ36R-AY7RFmccjFwfvCILRgSEfN-5N6VP6INzJ_rLgfDXcZ4cUyt1Fpy32UGJhCZY0e4k)

Forty.
That's how many times low-propensity voters need to be contacted before they reliably show up on Election Day.
Not four. Not fourteen. **Forty.**
And contacting voters works best when it comes from a **familiar face.**
A stranger at the door doesn’t move the needle. If we want their vote, we’ve got to send someone they've seen before, someone who knows their name, someone who's already called, texted, or knocked on their door this month.
**[This is why Turning Point PAC's ballot-chasing model is built different.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTZ9AAwAAAAAAhnV7iQ9dfG5W4XrrhZezb01nnuGzu3JwTYO0O56mUZk3qWSH2TX021Itjvr_7oxcCN8Dx-jT1Ib-GHEImsMWDQvwGhKRxp9LTeMhRkR)**

[FINANCE AND TRAIN A BALLOT CHASER](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTZ9AAwAAAAAAhnV7iQ--3N54y3i9NkBuyOOanqbuo3KTfsuOGaP8SRaV_ZrWiFIF9ks7kIfgkEZCvoHGaHe_fGnLjJawYq_yJduZCjF-bTEA7hGxTho)

We don't parachute volunteers in for a weekend blitz and call it a “ground game.”
Turning Point PAC embeds **trained, full-time ballot-chasers** in targeted precincts — the _same_ chasers, the _same_ doors, the _same_ voters — building real relationships week after week until their ballots are in the box.
That sustained presence is what low-propensity voters respond to (and how Charlie delivered all 5 swing states for President Trump in 2024).
**But turnout takes money**. That’s especially true in a midterm election where there’s no “Top of the ticket” generating natural enthusiasm and turnout. History shows many conservatives don’t vote in midterms unless someone makes them.
Early voting starts in less than 8 weeks. And the margin of our House majority — the margin that protects everything President Trump has built — will be decided by whether our people show up or stay home.
Forty contacts. A familiar face. Financed and sustained through November 3.
**That's the formula.[Your contribution DIRECTLY funds it.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTZ9AAwAAAAAAhnV7iQ_vskBPDclIgS1UMZn6AThbKSxvsOujiX8cJ-MMydJonZFbWVUB-5b3JYbhckCa0e-UxaOt3FPgW2XI08HYH7GYpNbpMkFh7f8)**

[PUT A FAMILIAR FACE ON CONSERVATIVE DOORS](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTZ9AAwAAAAAAhnV7iRAlFMGwFqfkswkMIsyEQtvLI9JhfsHtD1ZlIaTNfy0zfSiIBKI1i8wdIar8lDd_HyYfOqculiEZDnL94P39-lXWU3YGjI34PAd)

Turnout doesn't happen by accident.
It's financed. Contact by contact. Knock by knock. Face by face.
Help us save America.
For Charlie,

**Tyler Bowyer**
Executive Director
Turning Point PAC

This is a massive cover-up, a scandal that at any other point in American history would have ended in the impeachment and removal of a president.

---
| Friend,
---
| In the span of _a single week_ , ICE agents killed _three_ people.
---
| In Maine, an agent shot and killed Johan Sebastián Durán Guerrero, a 26-year-old with a valid work permit and Social Security number, as he sat in his car with his three-year-old daughter beside him. The next day in Florida, a man was struck and killed by a tractor trailer while fleeing immigration agents. Days before, in Houston, an agent shot and killed Lorenzo Salgado Araujo, a father of three and a small-business owner, as he drove.
---
| **There have now been** _**at least**_**11 murders by ICE since Trump took office.** But instead of accountability, the Trump administration is conducting a cover-up. The FBI was told it will no longer investigate violent incidents involving immigration agents. **Those cases will now be investigated by Homeland Security Investigations,**_**a branch of ICE itself.**_
---
| [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ltUbXl-6s0bIg4gQVcwFLatPTQDzu-GiUXgNNNg5R74HJu2M7c-I-oCXE2wc1mkpQHc32oS5ynGP5VTCExC8nCacNn74Mnnw4Q2xw4Drp2oZdFotf6SGnU_PexcmrR5bsbwJIAWIDnTaqlt1Rcik2N6PGWixRIib8o7wAFjyy6XdVwY4nBVx_ViOO-Zmp_AwNOWAyWDq0bQHe0WEhJBfMiOpzSWLH-HUU6bB9_NcJzZHXPThLE-9aKfmzfVWQK4PKW_41NfSN-I=&c=f9ExB65WdL6YTxBYSUm9nu2hWYDq2h4WOF9MDJCtc_Z2JxRz2PYUjA==&ch=HxWz78Al8y1tc2KiwyaVO_C_E47O2NggOZrYd3q13gJEzYgn64X71w==)
---
| **This is a massive cover-up, a scandal that at any other point in American history would have ended in the impeachment and removal of a president.**
---
| _And it’s no surprise the Trump admin is desperate to bury the truth._ The ACLU released a report that documented how ICE is routinely trampling constitutional rights in its violent operations. And recent reporting revealed that**the ICE agent behind the Maine shooting had a documented history of domestic violence, including assaulting his daughter and threatening to slit his wife’s throat.**
---
| [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ltUbXl-6s0bIg4gQVcwFLatPTQDzu-GiUXgNNNg5R74HJu2M7c-I-oCXE2wc1mkpQHc32oS5ynGP5VTCExC8nCacNn74Mnnw4Q2xw4Drp2oZdFotf6SGnU_PexcmrR5bsbwJIAWIDnTaqlt1Rcik2N6PGWixRIib8o7wAFjyy6XdVwY4nBVx_ViOO-Zmp_AwNOWAyWDq0bQHe0WEhJBfMiOpzSWLH-HUU6bB9_NcJzZHXPThLE-9aKfmzfVWQK4P5AMC_T2mf98=&c=f9ExB65WdL6YTxBYSUm9nu2hWYDq2h4WOF9MDJCtc_Z2JxRz2PYUjA==&ch=HxWz78Al8y1tc2KiwyaVO_C_E47O2NggOZrYd3q13gJEzYgn64X71w==)
---
| _These are the kind of people the Trump administration is handing a $50,000 signing bonus, a mask, and a gun before turning them loose on our streets._
---
| If Democrats retake the House and Senate this November, they reclaim control of key oversight committees, and with them the power to subpoena ICE officials, compel testimony under oath, and pry loose the documents this administration is burying right now. _Given what we know now about ICE, just imagine what's being hidden._
---
| **There is no doubt this is a major reason why Trump is working so hard to rig the midterms.**__ He knows what Democrats would find, so he's trying to kill the investigations and the elections that would empower the investigators, all at once. There _must_ be justice for the people ICE has murdered— _but none of it is possible unless we make this election too big to rig._
---
| **That's where Defend Our Courts comes in.** We're working to expand the firewall of state Supreme Courts on a national scale this November, and to turn out voters in the states with the House and Senate races that will decide who holds the power to investigate ICE’s crimes. _To do that at the scale this moment demands, we need your help right now:_

Can we count on you to rush a donation of $25, $15, or whatever you can spare to help us fight for free and fair elections and win big in November?](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ltUbXl-6s0bIg4gQVcwFLatPTQDzu-GiUXgNNNg5R74HJu2M7c-I-oCXE2wc1mkpDuXRdDF-btF6fh8cNt_F3xMSogEXWdgVNMNjDWx1AdwXu87Ei7_YLiGuenJ8iGAsJHLWqZNNcppX4levOTeajw0_N1sOA09FidOjf34WFNkZ-eII46u5PnqSBWyUyfGZ5HOIY_fJhX7EylDY2ZqSqzIZFeQFf4KJJcdCgj1nC4mwSuI4xm9N8fi8U4EA1gmMgohUzGs54DI=&c=f9ExB65WdL6YTxBYSUm9nu2hWYDq2h4WOF9MDJCtc_Z2JxRz2PYUjA==&ch=HxWz78Al8y1tc2KiwyaVO_C_E47O2NggOZrYd3q13gJEzYgn64X71w==)

body:
President Trump said on Saturday he would renew his push to get a controversial $1.776 billion 'anti-weaponization' fund codified into law [if the Senate does not confirm](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMGunSAURb8GZ9zAUREHDm7TMHuddNChAT0-T4tggCt5_frG-wsd72RnrfXrY_6w5Cl8_rAHTmWLc8CaPZaCaS7pdZwJL7owS-0o5e0V1hqPGQQoLjQXMK-W_NfcNeu0IQK2DU5y0L1SPQy62aex7UTnlHRKL2sHo1TSbs6h0lIvEmRD0_0mtAApxNCrhxv7XonWjp0eQNmBdQJXKjE9fkcKZcfNf8UL02OJR-OnvZQzs_bJwDAwtdbHkcO9MTAY-CszMLcUAxPLjomBeYvx81Uy3ylzGwrxivaMgf7aQjHwW5Q7u_zhMfCyIy_WeWRgbOLPJ4wLupO1Ji60svb7tzsg1vwT09mkaT0reU9Z3eifhyX_Ri3_1fea4F8AAAD__3iUj48) his attorney general pick, Todd Blanche.

| | |

| [](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DtuwzAQBNDTUJ0F7tL8qGARwFCKxC7SuBSocGUzoD6gKBG-faBcIfUM5gFzv3ZXF2KYHjc3ks3D3E1U1kg5U-py2sYl0R52WsH0Ia3DNvkyjx1yVCduThw770J8defK24EISVRkQRuplERtqqcdHAwKJBnFsXE9bwBQckCJRpDpRRXsscYNR-BcS1X3jZSKC9ecjUblNDtz8iHPqf6Zw5SfNMTXvFOqv-exivaZ87Iy8cawZdiWUurRp4XyETNsv9717XZh2IrPu2w-rkdNtFvwTFwAwDBU69YDExetAKpk_VJCjGFVB_wYXYh_UP7XO7vF3wAAAP__BUJzIQ) | |
# Sunday, August 2, 2026
---|---
**Good Morning!** On this day in 1876, ["Wild Bill" Hickok](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAURb8Gb7bwM2AyMHTxlq4dLRwe8WuwiYAY5e8rV-oXdD_3Hul8XeerpUD7_dNuaIqP8441BywF01zSa3smPOjA3OuFUvav3dW4zcBBtVy3HGZnKbxn0TjjEQGHBk0_aqmUhFE3q_E9Cm29kAv3Vl70AIuWo9QWtJC9uDVkzjeuOfScj1J1y0VKxQd7EXoEZUcmODoqMXXfkfayog_veGDqbnFrgllLeWY2fDCYGEy11s6hdTVGdwIMppVyienNYKLd2y2-cvtHnAMKrl0ohHal2yM-GExNMu5ZKQTK6rTfN0vh11b-legw8BMAAP__ScF6uA), one of the greatest gunfighters of the American West, was murdered in Deadwood, South Dakota, while playing poker. He was holding two pair, aces and eights, now known as the dead man's hand. Salisbury steak enjoyed its great heyday in the era of TV dinners and traditional cafeteria lunches. But over time, the simple ground-beef-and-gravy main plate, a Civil War-era invention, has become little more than a nostalgia entree, as we are reminded in today's _[Whatever Happened To...](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJy0kbFutDAQhJ_GdJzMArYpXPwN3f1tSrTg5djE2Mj2cbq3j8grROmmGM3o0_dxn-7InsPjP-5kyxqnQK_sqRRKU0nP_Uh08km5MTOnvD6De8V9AgmqlqaWMDlk_566ytmVCKityDba9Er1oE212W6Qy6DngXBphwWVwbnR8wwKe0VkdMX2WpNGQiOl7tVtHvpeyRaHzmhQqEUnyXGJ6fYZOZSNVv-OJ6XbEvfK262UI4v2n4BRwJh5Pzx5XmkjTIUCh0e-mgJGkNALGOUgYGyuFL2rV8wbx0Cuzug5z8_0rnMh_KoTLXyQgPHvH6pk3fFi7zmri_exI_sfvvIrKaeF7wAAAP__c6GgjA)_ In case you missed it, this week on _The Flyover Podcast_ , Ayla tackled the science behind what your dreams are actually made of. **Whatever happened to Salisbury steak?** The gravy-smothered ground beef patty that once symbolized modern American convenience actually started as a health food. Its slide from TV-dinner star to cafeteria punchline is one of the great demotions in culinary history. Salisbury steak is named for Dr. James Henry Salisbury, a 19th-century New York physician and [early germ-theory researcher](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2OpDAQxfHTQGZkCvxB4GATst50Q2Sg3NSOwS27APXtRz1XmPzp6af_v8f08BTpeP71OzoOaTrwLhGZMU-cz_2V8aILS2tnyiWcx3qnfQIJWkgrJEyrp_ie-np1ARGwq9G1xiqtFRhbb04ZK_tWgjaDMa1ScujMsvYBls6HoOaa3OdNWgmtlEbpZh6U0rLzQ28NaG-qXuJKnHLzP9HBG4b4ThfmZkl7Hd3G_CpV96eCsYLxvu-m7MRbSQf5Y_fPz6yC0WcuYjkjnxkrGIuPVOYzv0Vh9F9ioYuiuH0WG_rImwgpraK1yvaD6SoY6-zW100xUtEf0nP3FH8I_Ktul4PvAAAA__8zyIFi) who became convinced during the Civil War that vegetables and starches were poisoning people from the inside out. His prescription: lean minced beef three times a day, washed down with hot water. He published his findings in 1888, setting off one of America's earliest fad diets. The name stuck for good during World War I, when anti-German sentiment made "hamburger steak" sound unpatriotic. By mid-century, Salisbury steak had found its true calling: the frozen TV dinner. When [Swanson rolled out its aluminum-tray meals in the 1950s](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSozAQRL9GZLiGAQkIFFxC5ksvpCRrZOZWSJQk4_Lfb7G_sFkHXd2v3r_7ejccOD7_mp109WmN9C6BaqW81vzaj0wnn1S6yXIu_hXdO-0rAqoWphZwdYbDZx0apz0RUt-Q7sZJKiVxnJpNo0SDOM8PZQc_OzmCVRJ6sGhnaR01rK81mAA7gFGqm52lVNCbeZhGVGYUA5DjmvLtf-JYN_Lhk07Kt0fam6C3Wo8i-j8CF4FL4f0IFNjTRiZXihyf5WoKXBBQClxgFrh0V0rBtd6UjVMk1xYTuNhX_rSlkvlqMz34IIFLk7U73hwCF3XRPHfD4ee9_krZqfE7AAD__1r_fvs), those gravy-bathed patties became comfort food for a generation eating in front of _I Love Lucy_. But the format that made it famous eventually dragged it down. As Americans embraced global cuisine and health-conscious eating, the dish became shorthand for everything processed and institutional, the dreaded "mystery meat" on a cafeteria tray. It hasn't vanished, though. It's just gone undercover. Chains like Bob Evans and LongHorn Steakhouse [have it on the menu](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGOpDAQheHTQAYyZbBN4GATst50Q1SGoqkdAy27APXtRz1XmPhJ75P-f4_xgRx5f_7Fjbwsx7jTnSOJUBolndsr0cUX5cYFTnk59_k-thEUmEq5SsE4I8f32JazX4iAdEm-sa4zpgPrytWHtm36oGDRk25Q95ZcQFwmjX3fumBL9p835RQ0StnO1KHvOqM09q2zYNAWraKZ5Uj1_4N3WWmJ7-OiVE_HVka_irxyof8UMBQw3PddE4qsnD97AUOgLFWiLHgm3KWaVuQ9Vxkj53Cmd5WF8KuAoUx-ft0cI2fzQZ8bcvxB5FdlLg_fAQAA___H93i4), often rebranded as "chopped steak." Stauffer's and other frozen-food vendors also [still stock the frozen version](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFurDAQheGngc7IGGygcHEbur1tSmSWmWUSg5FnFrR5-mjzCqmPdD7p_7hNt0CR9sf_sIEXTNMOF0cQgTxJfm5HhpNO4LqfKTM-9-VK22S0cUr3SptpCRRfU1suHgEMNCX4uuutc9Z0fbn64d6ia7DB1tUOYQaj9bxYi9iidXooyb_fdK9NrXVnXTUP1jrdhKHtO-NCV7QaFpKUq89Eu6yA8ZVOyNU9bWX0q8jBRfOvMGNhxuu6KggiK_F7L8w4A4vCnL5hVxwi8fzML8UC4YtVhhDVDICK13QckLkwY5n9clwUI7F7648tUPzV5E-JTm9-AgAA__8vInwQ), and home cooks have given it a nostalgia-fueled revival online. The gravy-smothered ground beef patty that once symbolized modern American convenience actually started as a health food. Its slide from TV-dinner star to cafeteria punchline is one of the great demotions in culinary history. Salisbury steak is named for Dr. James Henry Salisbury, a 19th-century New York physician and who became convinced during the Civil War that vegetables and starches were poisoning people from the inside out. His prescription: lean minced beef three times a day, washed down with hot water. He published his findings in 1888, setting off one of America's earliest fad diets. The name stuck for good during World War I, when anti-German sentiment made "hamburger steak" sound unpatriotic. By mid-century, Salisbury steak had found its true calling: the frozen TV dinner. When , those gravy-bathed patties became comfort food for a generation eating in front of I Love Lucy. But the format that made it famous eventually dragged it down. As Americans embraced global cuisine and health-conscious eating, the dish became shorthand for everything processed and institutional, the dreaded "mystery meat" on a cafeteria tray. It hasn't vanished, though. It's just gone undercover. Chains like Bob Evans and LongHorn Steakhouse , often rebranded as "chopped steak." Stauffer's and other frozen-food vendors also , and home cooks have given it a nostalgia-fueled revival online. Salisbury steak isn't gone, just demoted from the main stage to a quiet corner of the comfort food canon. Did you ever have a Salisbury steak frozen dinner, or try Salisbury steak in a restaurant? ## Texas Orders Halt to Border Clearing
Texas Land Commissioner Dawn Buckingham ordered U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) on Friday to [stop a contractor](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO5CAMhp-GdIyAJEAKimvo9torIyd2EnQERsDO7rz9KaO5J9jKxaff9v_9-Zg_IMSQ9t9wkmvfW54TfdVIrVGZa4NGB8RWl1yQyhoJSkj7MiuhNBeWCzUjhPichw7dInCSHTlp7Ki1HUfVHU5bmHowCKuWtBrZj8syEdphwmGjyXTBXcuEFUpKoXp5k2bSwm5kcdRo0LJBEIaWy60d1Ogb6haf-UHltuazi-5o7V5Z_4spz5T_-whwAab81YQp_4ow5a8zTHlhmPK9_A94hIR8zecZag05UeGVEla-ElTiF0SqoTa-5cIhRtoJebgmxHf4rYWHxI9PrHdqB1_zZ2pPpnxXHN6_QoyhasMGsZ8Q4uv19jPhD6f-BQAA__9Uopa7) from clearing state land in Presidio County for the border wall. The General Land Office says Barnard Construction trespassed across several sections of a 10,000-acre grazing lease and used heavy equipment to blade the terrain and strip every plant in its path. "_We will work with our federal partners to keep the southern border secured, but we will not compromise the integrity of Texas state property to do it,_ " Buckingham said. She wants the ground restored to its original condition. Buckingham's order comes after Presidio and the county's economic development group [sued the federal government](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L3yoyAUBfCnwQ4HbhRJQbENXbbd0kG5KLMoGbgTk7ff0Z08wb8-cz_O789jfLiY4r78dhsaeoc87njUhERYxkqOcHWJ6pSLxzIndCXuyzSCAMWF5gJG72L6jF3jzST8XTZo5KB7pXTfQ7MaFZQGPwxC333AGbtJ6VliF1zfOx_mJppzmdACpBRwk60c7krogNr3yg9es06gj5RLSysSvl0N6ZNfWNo5b00yK9GzstsvBpaBPY6j_VsdnSEDe7ZhYK8xBvY8xcCKgYG9yW_Ak9s9n_O2xVpj3rHwq2_lAX3llHml_OQxJVxcSh_-heCXEP-vw6m4mRjYphj_PGJKsaqBdWLZXEzXs_Qz4peBfwEAAP__33iSOg) over the Big Bend barrier plan, arguing the barriers will cause flooding along the Rio Grande.
## Equipment Causes Methodist Hospital Fire
Houston firefighters carried extinguishers and buckets of water up the stairs of [Houston Methodist's Centennial Tower](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2u5CAQBk-DM0aAbcABwSbOZtMNrba7GSNhY0Frfm6_mneFF3_SV6X6d1_ukHI6H3_hoMDvWJaTXi0TM9WlMTDtkLmtpSLVLRPUdD7WxShjpfJSmQUh5c8ydBhWhZPuKGjnR2v9OJpuD8oqBz2B89voV2f9BAjRwQDTZjGaLoXvmfLKaK1Mr2_aTVb5SB5Hiw69GBRh4lJvvBPTG1rMn_KketvK0eWwM19N9H-EmYWZYd10_12Ema_SWJh5q_RqslK7yokypkqylhLlQbwXTI3lXtqVGLLcI8oGnybMrL8WfhiFmbsa8HqlnFOzTgzqcUDKP3T-XbNnMP8DAAD__28WgK0) on Friday because the high-rise's fire pipes were dry. The call came in just after 5 p.m., to the wrong address. Crews who found their way to the Texas Medical Center tower met heavy fire and smoke on the roof and pulled a second alarm. Fire pipes were without water because the tower is under construction, so firefighters hauled what they could up to the fire by hand while working with building staff to get the pipes flowing. Once the pipes had water, the fire was put out. It never reached the floors below, and nobody was hurt. Preliminary investigations suggest that a [rooftop chiller started the blaze](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAURb_G3rAAx5gMDF28pWtHC5tHjIp50eM1Tv6-Sts_6Hp0dXXv-bjMF59yKtd3v4PjR8S5wFEzMAPNlT3D5jPXBSkArRk8pXJdZi21EdIKqefgU37Opza4RYazasGp0Q7G2GHQ7ebMsvTWxt6salyNHJXxi1cWolZSen9uk3uVSSu1UlL3qlPj2UgbwYbBhDHY5iQhJEbqeAOGh68xP_EO1K24t9ltzLfa9G-Nnho9HcfRRXxos-FXZSyvUKOn16tGT39Q7MAbhlRZxEQg6o6fIAhuSAxBEGIUKxSGUpLPgvEAEjuEX0gtuXA7Us6pmrE5yevuU_5Zw_9zeHf6OwAA___-YYmY).
## State Strips Buckholts Police of Authority

body:
10,000 votes 10 years ago

# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk822_rs&source=&t=1&akid=2342%2E124072%2EVJ5n5u)
| | | |
---
Peter,
At the end of this message, I’m going to ask you to chip in $5 to my Senate campaign here in North Carolina. [**_If you’re ready to give now, you can use this link to donate._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk822_rs&amount=5&t=8&akid=2342%2E124072%2EVJ5n5u)
**Otherwise, please let me explain why your support is so important and what could happen without it.**
In 2016, I ran for Governor for the first time.
I was fighting to unseat Republican Governor Pat McCrory. Nobody had defeated an incumbent Governor in North Carolina for more than 150 years, but I knew that we had the team behind us to win and make history.
Throughout the race, multiple election experts were saying it was a “Toss Up.” Poll after poll showed me with a slight – or sometimes even large – lead. The momentum was on our side.
**However, on election night, the race was too close to call.**
I ended that night with a less than 5,000-vote lead – which might sound like a lot but is a razor-thin margin in North Carolina, especially given the 4.6 million ballots cast. It was less than half of 1%.
Governor McCrory didn’t concede. He claimed that there had been voter fraud in our state with no evidence to back it up.
He called for a recount, and over the next month, he and his team continued spreading baseless conspiracy theories and undermining faith in the democratic process.
**Yet on Dec. 5, 2016, democracy won. The recount was wrapped up, and the results were in: We had won the race by 10,277 votes.**
Peter, this current Senate race is starting to remind me a lot of my 2016 race.
Just like in 2016, the momentum today appears to be on our side.
The polls show me with a slight advantage, and experts have increased our odds of winning. Even though President Trump carried North Carolina each of the three times he ran, the experts are saying that this is the best chance for Democrats to flip a Republican-held seat in the country.
Here’s what worries me...
**We could have just as easily lost that race in 2016. Despite all of the winds blowing in our favor, we still only won by 10,277 votes – just 0.22%.**
That’s why we simply cannot take our foot off the gas. We cannot look at the polls and the predictions and think for a second that we have this in the bag. We cannot give our Republican opponent or the right-wing super PACs supporting him an inch.
**I won in 2016 – in the same election that President Trump first won the presidency – only because of grassroots support from people like you. That’s how I plan to win again, but I need you with me.**
[**_Please, Peter: Will you chip in $5, or whatever you can, today to help us flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate for Democrats?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk822_rs&amount=5&t=9&akid=2342%2E124072%2EVJ5n5u)

Thank you for reading. I appreciate it.

I'm Abby, and I'm the Coordinated Campaign Director for the North Carolina Democratic Party. My job is to help lead our incredible team of organizers who are fighting for Democrats up and down the ballot, all across the state. That includes this critical U.S. Senate race.
We know this fight isn't going to be easy so we've been working hard to build a fantastic team that will show up for Roy Cooper in every corner of North Carolina.
We're knocking every weekend, in every district, to make sure folks know exactly what's at stake this November. We're talking with voters about the issues they actually care about, and we're mobilizing volunteers across the state.
Just last weekend, we knocked on more than **28,000 doors across all 100 counties!**
[](https://substack.com/redirect/0768ac23-9d1c-4ac4-af2b-e2c37b58960a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

[](https://substack.com/redirect/63379ccd-45f4-4403-8de9-0ca0dac693fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Instagram
[View on Instagram](https://substack.com/redirect/63379ccd-45f4-4403-8de9-0ca0dac693fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In this work, every conversation teaches you something and brings to light the challenges people are facing across our state. I was out canvassing in Raleigh earlier this summer, and a few of those conversations really stuck with me.
I talked to a lot of younger voters who weren't just excited to vote for Roy but wanted to bring their friends along too. They get it. They understand just how critical this election is and the power they have to shape their own communities. It was a good reminder that one conversation can multiply fast, and a single door can end up reaching a lot further.
We are building an incredible grassroots movement that I am so proud to be a part of. But none of this fight is possible without our amazing volunteers on the ground, and they're just getting started. We need to talk to as many voters as possible about why Governor Cooper is the right choice for North Carolina before early voting starts in 75 days.
This is ongoing, important work that will continue happening between now and Election Day. Whether you're able to join a canvas in-person, hop on a virtual phone bank or talk to your friends about this race, know that you're taking an important step in sending Governor Cooper to Washington.

name: Free Speech Daily Sponsor
subject: Is the UN about to seize 400,000 acres of American soil?
body:
The only thing standing between the UN’s 400,000-acre power grab and American soil is one decision.
---
| | | | | |
---
| | | | | [View in browser](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTZ9AAwAAAAAAhprk1zkFgJGF9wRcigHA9tdSu4O3p6DKzIPPtWkSEhhUhtvpZSgLXW8zvcYrtd4VP5KZ7rvD9Z5rM1G6tpTZqNLqRhdpRfjjk9ipXBS "View in Browser")
---
_**A Special Message from our Sponsor**_ _Please note that views expressed in this message do not necessarily reflect those of_ _Free Speech Daily_ _and do not constitute an endorsement or recommendation by Free Speech Daily_ _._
---
| *|MC_PREVIEW_TEXT|* | | | | [ ](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTZ9AAwAAAAAAhprk1zl9s69gnkEVdn5wrOvk0ecOb_eesfhEDBn8vuMMU0FqrXWFS0-Qo1LX6QvXxEerg9ySx8OYdqyvsqij2oF1J7OtRO6DZKdaLB5)
---
| | Dear Fellow Patriot,

On July 19, a committee of 21 foreign governments gavels into session in Busan, South Korea – and somewhere in the days that follow, they’ll decide whether a 400,000-acre stretch of Georgia answers to them.

Not to Georgia. Not to America.

To _them_ – the United Nations.

And don’t kid yourself that it stops at one swamp. Hand the UN 400,000 acres of Georgia and you’ve handed them the precedent – the next piece of America comes easier, and the one after that easier still.

I’m Craig Rucker, President of CFACT – the Committee for a Constructive Tomorrow – and I want to give you a frank update on what the United Nations is actually up to right now.

Last weekend, you and I were lighting fireworks for America’s 250th birthday – a quarter of a millennium since a handful of farmers and shopkeepers told the most powerful empire on earth to take its crown and its tax collectors and pound sand.

**And now, before the smoke clears, the UN’s culture bureaucrats want to plant their flag in the Okefenokee Swamp.**

They don’t call it a flag, of course. They call it a “World Heritage Site” – a designation of “outstanding universal value.” (Translation: it’s not really yours anymore.)

The UN swears it would “only monitor” this swath of American land. (Right – the way a fox “only monitors” the henhouse.) Ask the folks in Charlton, Ware, and Clinch counties in Georgia what “monitor” means.

They’re the ones who’d wake up to find their hunting land, their timber, their own backyards redrawn as a “buffer zone” to “protect” a swamp that’s been doing just fine on its own since before there was a United Nations to mismanage it.

No hunting. No logging. No pulling weeds. No say. That’s the “universal value” on offer.

[**Will you please add your name to CFACT’s Declaration of Independence from the UN to tell President Trump and Interior Secretary Doug Burgum to pull this nomination off the table before the July 19 deadline**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTZ9AAwAAAAAAhprk1zmWSaE_7JDbrsJAE-yCBPrrdkff0EtvWB430fhDOOBmTpI6H-p3_q6VbVs0LbR4cCcJEpl4mSza3N0r84G4JkRwUFM508jSTNL)?
[**Add My Name to the Declaration >>**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTZ9AAwAAAAAAhprk1znEP7UQ6zb_PqDzblL67CjnqB7QlhGLC3BYt60JGk3ZFBsfL0Us-OaNXe_HlKrS_nY9LyFnNbFGNuSaIK6KR5VK8-POuas3Z8Y)
So how did we get here? A midnight gift in January 2025.

The Okefenokee sat on a UN “tentative list” for some 40 years, going nowhere – until the Biden administration, just before clearing out its desks, rammed through the nomination without so much as a phone call to the people who actually live there.

**A parting gift to the UN – from the same crew that spent four years handing out pieces of American sovereignty to anyone who asked.**

And the outfit advising the UN on whether to bless it?

The International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) – the global green bureaucracy whose own network brags about cramming climate “education” into the Paris accord that Trump already tore up.

This was never about alligators and peat moss. **It’s about handing a chunk of America to the climate agenda’s permanent government – the one nobody elected and nobody can fire.**

President Trump already walked America out of UNESCO – one of 66 international outfits he’s shown the door to, including the UN’s climate convention itself. Good.

But walking out of UNESCO alone doesn’t stop this.

**The nomination rides a separate track, and the United States is still bound to the “World Heritage Convention.”**

Which means unless Secretary Burgum formally rescinds it, those 21 foreign governments get the final word on American soil – whether we’re members of their little club or not.

One signature stands between the UN and the Okefenokee – Secretary Burgum’s, on an order pulling this nomination off the table. _That’s the whole fight, in a single stroke of a pen_.

This is exactly the fight CFACT was built for.

Our team went to Folkston, Georgia – cameras rolling – and sat down with the county commissioners the UN never bothered to consult, and put their warnings on the record while the national press looked the other way.

**We’re also one of the only conservative outfits holding official NGO observer status at the United Nations – which means when they convene, we have the standing to be in the room and fight them to their faces.**

That’s the difference between a think tank and a DO tank. And because we don’t take one dime of taxpayer money, there isn’t a globalist on this earth who can buy us off or shut us up.

_The good news?_ This fight is winnable, and the momentum is ours.

Three counties have already passed ordinances against it. When the UN’s own advisors held their little meeting down in Folkston, it did not go the way they planned.

America has walked away from UNESCO before – under Reagan, and again under Trump. The pattern is hard to miss: when Americans actually show up, the globalists lose.

So let’s show up.

[**Add your name to the Declaration today – and then chip in $25, $50, or $100 to keep CFACT’s boots on the ground for the next land grab, because there is always a next one**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTZ9AAwAAAAAAhprk1zojtciyitip9olt-H-lEiDAYCLANJELwYoNBRjuWLJBzki6y3f4z3_x5RW-zYTKF69pEMRJy9nMJi3PjwednQIe3uwKkYUkTpC).

Two hundred and fifty years ago, we declared our independence from a faraway power that thought it owned us.

It’s time to do it again.

For American sovereignty,

Craig Rucker
President

P.S. – Twenty-one foreign governments are about to vote on a piece of Georgia, fifteen days after we celebrate 250 years of telling distant powers exactly where to put their opinions about our land. [**Add your name before July 19 – and let’s make this Independence Day mean something**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTZ9AAwAAAAAAhprk1zpPomWUrxM92wphEGJ0DDMjCIYIbiib5kTYIC1OiA3hLVmjogi-LbZgyFH04xwBwniT1GFyK7aMW03u1vu9KdRB0YEHKojcj5P).
[**Add My Name to the Declaration >>**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTZ9AAwAAAAAAhprk1zqCMM4qi5my9bobBwZ7-cmxLtqbWnjZWm21yCZxBm-LMOrkqsWFMUEFl9IxIKe3pmkD_tgjc97csrJDeHwh74T39luZWfvn94u)

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. Peter. apparently the [**The Mighty 990**](https://us.list-manage.com/1AKqeIVOdeA?e=9dd54a4530&c2id=5d5fb3bbb9d76dabda4faf1cf6e79b6d) is trying to help me win. They posted the attached screenshot about me telling the truth about Brent Taylor.
Here is my response:"Now that Early Voting has ended, I can address The Mighty 990.
Thank you THE MIGHTY 990 for this extra publicity. I have stood toe-to-toe with Justin Pearson and London Lamar in multiple candidate forums in Shelby County during this election.
I stood strong in the fire during debates and gained respect from many of the voters in the audience, because I'm not afraid of the Democrats.
MY REPUBLICAN OPPONENTS SHOWED FEAR AND WOULD NOT SHOW UP TO DEBATE THE DEMOCRATS!
The event sponsors were expecting Brent Taylor. So they took Brent's table tent sign, scratched his name off, and wrote my name on the back. I still have the actual table tent sign.
How can Brent defeat his opponent if he is afraid to face the opponent when it matters?Is there a record of Brent ever facing off against Justin Pearson when Justin was being very disruptive in the General Assembly? Brent was there! What did he do? NOTHING. There's your answer.
Well, I have faced Pearson and Lamar, and for the citizens in the 9th district, I will do it again, I have proof, and I will defeat him. My mama didn't raise me to quit on the mission, or to allow fear to stop me from completing the mission." ~ [**Charlotte Bergmann**](https://us.list-manage.com/aV9ZGjYz6Io?e=9dd54a4530&c2id=5d5fb3bbb9d76dabda4faf1cf6e79b6d) [**Charlotte Bergmann for Congress**](https://us.list-manage.com/le9Nf1EF91x?e=9dd54a4530&c2id=5d5fb3bbb9d76dabda4faf1cf6e79b6d)

# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
The stakes of this race are high, Peter. Not just for Texas but for the whole country.
Here’s why. Texas is growing fast. It’s already the country’s second biggest state population-wise, and after the next census, we’re projected to gain 4-5 more congressional seats.
That means Texas will soon hold more influence over the U.S. House of Representatives and the Electoral College than ever before.
If Greg Abbott remains in power, Republicans will use recent Supreme Court rulings to draw extreme, rigged maps and lock in partisan control over Congress and the White House for an entire generation.
That is why the Texas Governor’s race is so important, not just for Texans, but for every American. . And it’s also why we’re mobilizing across Texas to ensure that when November comes around, we have the turnout needed to flip key legislative seats across Texas.
We’re more organized than ever — so when I win, we will win all those seats and shatter the GOP's grip on our state.

subject: He’s leading the working-class fight against data centers
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Justin J. Pearson isn’t even in Congress yet, and he’s already taking on
Elon Musk:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260802-1-jjp.Vl-3Hr&refcode=em20260802-38118&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=38118%2E1203867%2EIZmkHG ]Tweet by More Perfect Union: Memphis is home to Elon Musk’s data center
empire — and the polluting turbines xAI uses to power them appear to be
making residents sick. Justin Parson has been leading the fight against
them, and is now running for Congress to elevate the fight to protect his
community. Pearson is running in a district that Tennessee Republicans
just gerrymandered, but in sticking to his progressive working class
values, and channeling the rage at xAI’s noise, pollution, and
lawlessness, he could pull off a historic upset.

This JD-endorsed state representative is on the ballot for Tennessee’s 9th
congressional district in this Thursday’s primary election, giving us just
four more days to get out the vote and move him one step closer to
fighting for Memphis in Congress.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260802-1-jjp.Vl-3Hr&refcode=em20260802-38118&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=38118%2E1203867%2EIZmkHG ]Can we count on you to split a contribution to Justice Democrats and
Justin’s campaign now to power our final days of this race?

When he was just 25, Justin led his community in organizing against the
Byhalia oil pipeline. He helped lead a coalition that successfully forced
two billion-dollar corporations to back down and abandon their projects
that would have further polluted a community plagued by environmental
racism for decades.

South Memphis is a poor, predominantly Black community with a long history
of industrial pollution and resulting health issues like asthma and
cancer. Now, it’s being treated as a sacrifice zone for Big Tech,
including Elon Musk’s xAI.

But Justin and the people of Memphis are fighting back with everything
they’ve got.

As Justin told folks at his rally last week, “Elon came into our community
without the consent of our community to build toxic data centers. So we
fought back against the largest hyperscale data center in the world. We
forced them to get permits they didn’t want to get."

Memphis is serving as a role model for other cities and towns across the
country that are rising up to block these projects, pass moratoriums, and
ban the building of toxic data centers that put profits before public
health — and Justin is a major reason for that.

Now, we have the chance to send him to Washington to join the rest of our
progressive bloc in holding Big Tech accountable while raising wages,
passing Medicare for All, abolishing ICE, and ending U.S. funding for
Israel’s genocide in Gaza.

Despite facing racist gerrymandering from the Tennessee GOP designed to
eliminate this blue district, Justin has built a people-powered movement
uniting working-class folks from different backgrounds to fight back
against a system designed against us.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260802-1-jjp.Vl-3Hr&refcode=em20260802-38118&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1004&akid=38118%2E1203867%2EIZmkHG ]Let’s give Justin the final boost he needs to win this primary and
advance to the general election in November: pitch in $10 or
whatever you can spare to fuel our movement to victory on Thursday!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260802-1-jjp.Vl-3Hr&refcode=em20260802-38118&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1023&akid=38118%2E1203867%2EIZmkHG ]Contribute $10

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20260802-38118-footer&t=1024&refcode2=38118_1203867_IZmkHG&akid=38118%2E1203867%2EIZmkHG

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://go.justicedemocrats.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1025&akid=38118%2E1203867%2EIZmkHG

Peter, starting tomorrow, Maryland will kick off a three-day special legislative session to explore steps to redraw the state’s maps for 2028. This will be the latest response to the Republican redistricting crisis that’s spiraling out across the country. As Governor Moore put it, “Doing nothing is not an option.” These words ring as urgent as ever with anti-democracy forces ramping up their efforts to manipulate the maps in the aftermath of the Supreme Court gutting the Voting Rights Act. **What’s happening in Maryland underscores the pressing need to elect fair-minded folks to state government so that we’re not just countering Republican redraws but building the political power to ban gerrymandering and end this crisis once and for all. ** [**With your help, the NDRC can continue to execute our multi-pronged strategy to fight back against Republican attacks on democracy. Peter, a reporter
asked me a question at our press conference that was designed to be a
little bit of a gotcha. It was actually a good question, too.

I've been loud about the dark money flooding into this race — the kind of
group that doesn't have to disclose donors. Over $61 million has been
spent to prop up our opponent, Haley Stevens. So, the reporter asked: have
I ever turned down support from a dark money group that wanted to back
*my* campaign?

Here's the honest answer I gave, and I want you to sit with it for a
second:

“I don't take those meetings, and they don't come to me in
the first place.”

That's not me dodging. That's the whole point.

Dark money doesn't knock on your door unless it knows you'll open it.
These groups don't waste a dollar. They spend because they know exactly
what they're trying to buy: a vote in the U.S. Senate.

* Big Pharma wants a senator who looks the other way on prescription
drug prices.
* Big Tech wants free rein to put data centers in our backyards and
raise our utility bills.
* AIPAC wants a vote to send $3.3 billion of your tax dollars overseas
instead of investing it in our schools and infrastructure.

They looked at our campaign, and they knew: there's nothing here for sale.
So they took their money elsewhere.

In fact, they've trucked $61 million into this primary against us, more
outside spending than any Democratic Senate primary candidate has ever
withstood in history. More than half of it comes from AIPAC.

Think about the opportunity cost of that money. You can eliminate medical
debt for a penny on the dollar. When I served in Wayne County, we started
the work of eliminating up to $700 million in medical debt. That $61
million could’ve wiped out roughly $6.1 billion in medical debt for
American families.

Instead, it's buying 30-second misleading ads.

So here's where you come in, and I need you to hear the urgency in this.
Our primary is on August 4th — this Tuesday. That's all the time we have
left to prove that the many can beat the money.

This is the last stretch,
Peter. There won’t be another
primary day to make this case. Every dollar between now and Tuesday either
answers their $61 million or it doesn't.

They have the money. We have the many. Our campaign runs on people like
you, because I’ve never taken corporate money and I never will.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260802-1-ak.oxAKe5&amount=10&refcode=em20260802-2797&t=1004&akid=2806%2E251025%2EhH4ZCG ]Chip in $10 or any amount right now, before Tuesday, to
prove that Michigan's Senate seat is not for sale.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260802-1-ak.oxAKe5&amount=10&refcode=em20260802-2797&t=1023&akid=2806%2E251025%2EhH4ZCG ]Donate $10 ››

I know I ask a lot of you in these emails. But we're at the end of this
campaign now, and there is so little time left. So if you can help right
now, this is the moment. Thanks for reading this far, and for being part
of this.

Your friend in the fight,

Abdul

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d279c28f-75dc-40b6-b85e-827c42c25fd5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

A wave of youth-led protests has been sweeping the globe, and it is [unlike anything we've seen since the Arab Spring](https://substack.com/redirect/8d8b4c5f-936d-4f1d-8f7b-3a6b1bdf7399?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Over the past three years, Gen Z protesters have toppled governments, stormed parliaments, and forced presidents to flee their own palaces. [Bloomberg suggests the unrest is being driven by a generation "crushed by soaring rents and living costs and staring down a future where robots and AI threaten their jobs](https://substack.com/redirect/d1593032-13d6-49eb-846d-2d91e872e746?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." The protests are leaderless, organized on TikTok and Discord, and spreading across three continents with a speed that has caught governments completely off guard.
Here's the scorecard (so far):
* **Sri Lanka (2022)** : Protesters [stormed the presidential palace](https://substack.com/redirect/59b9c8a6-605a-42df-b49c-0d26405cae71?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) over economic collapse and President Rajapaksa fled the country.
* **Bangladesh (2024)** : Students ousted PM Sheikh Hasina's 15-year rule over a [corrupt government jobs quota system](https://substack.com/redirect/59b9c8a6-605a-42df-b49c-0d26405cae71?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg); over 1,400 were killed. Nobel laureate Muhammad Yunus was installed as interim leader and Hasina was sentenced to death in absentia.
* **Kenya (2024, 2026)** : Gen Z [stormed parliament and burned part of it](https://substack.com/redirect/c4222668-79b1-417f-8311-7d0406415b71?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), forcing President Ruto to withdraw a $2.7 billion tax bill. Dozens were killed, and the protests restarted this year.
* **Serbia (2024)** : A [train station collapse in Novi Sad](https://substack.com/redirect/59b9c8a6-605a-42df-b49c-0d26405cae71?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) triggered massive anti-corruption protests led by students demanding accountability for systemic negligence.
* **Nepal (2025)** : [PM KP Sharma Oli was toppled](https://substack.com/redirect/6054b6ef-8fe2-4458-8902-1cf1d622ed99?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by youth-led protests over corruption and economic mismanagement.
* **Indonesia (2025)** : Youth protested [parliamentary salary hikes and corruption in school meals](https://substack.com/redirect/59b9c8a6-605a-42df-b49c-0d26405cae71?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The government rescinded the salary increase.
* **Morocco (2025)** : The ["Gen-Z 212" movement](https://substack.com/redirect/8d8b4c5f-936d-4f1d-8f7b-3a6b1bdf7399?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was a mass protest over economic conditions. Thousands were arrested and handed harsh prison sentences.
* **Philippines (2025)** : Corruption in flood-control projects led to protests that forced the [House speaker to resign](https://substack.com/redirect/6054b6ef-8fe2-4458-8902-1cf1d622ed99?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* **Madagascar (2025)** : The [government fell](https://substack.com/redirect/c11a643d-1367-483e-b72a-b3ef470cc7c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to youth protests over economic mismanagement and corruption.
* **Tanzania (2025)** : Post-election youth protests were met with a [brutal crackdown; more than 1,000 were killed](https://substack.com/redirect/29922d62-676f-4076-aeef-983e4f9c6d82?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

**And don 't forget about the United States. **That same generational frustration and economic anger are fueling the rise of democratic socialism and leading to the elections of far-left candidates across the country, most notably in New York City.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/2d6d3d28-8779-46cf-9573-0948a0c94ead?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
So, what do protesters in Dhaka, Nairobi, and New York City have in common? To start, they are all young. These movements are all about promises that today's young feel are not being honored. And these young people are for the most part **over-educated and under-employed**. They did what they were told--studied hard, got degrees, played by the rules. But then they discovered the economy had no place for them. Throw in the power of social media and these disruptive youth movements have viral potential; they are leaderless, decentralized...and spread quickly.
Not surprisingly, the risk of unrest is especially pronounced in countries with a **youth bulge** , often thought to populations where more than 20% are between 15 and 29 years of age. In Africa, for example, [60% of the population is under 25](https://substack.com/redirect/d4c66f4c-5c1e-4d29-834a-1cee3a909d6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The Council on Foreign Relations (CFR) has found that large cohorts of young adults with limited opportunities "exacerbate unemployment, prolong dependency on parents, diminish self-esteem and fuel frustrations."
And then there's what political scientists call the **surplus male theory** : the argument, laid out in Valerie Hudson's [Bare Branches](https://substack.com/redirect/7c1ad5c5-fe3a-4f0b-b912-1c1e49b44df6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), suggests societies with large numbers of young men with limited marital and economic prospects tend to either go to war or take to the streets. The logic is straightforward: young men with nothing to lose and no stake in the system are a dry tinderbox; inequality and joblessness are matches that transform their despair into protest.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/9d3ff23c-ebf9-44de-a35a-dc070e408821?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
It now appears it's India's turn. India's Chief Justice recently called unemployed youth and social media activists ["cockroaches" and "parasites."](https://substack.com/redirect/147a0647-2bc8-453b-8cba-cabd8a591335?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) The insult inspired a digital strategist named Abhijeet Dipke to turn the slur into a brand. The **Cockroach Janta Party (CJP)** went from satirical meme into one of the fastest growing political movements in Indian history.
Recent revelations of corruption have thrown fuel onto a simmering fire leading to significant youth unrest. [Massive paper leaks in India's 2026 national examinations](https://substack.com/redirect/a64a2f61-e651-49de-b989-f2344d0e618d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), including the NEET medical entrance exam, led many to believe the supposed meritocracy of exams was a smokescreen hiding corruption. **In a country where exam scores determine your career, your income, and your marriage prospects, a rigged exam is more than a scandal, it 's an existential crisis.** Students who studied for years learned the test had been sold before it was presented. Some committed suicide.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/b40e3ff8-5d5d-4738-ada6-e825fbadef07?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thousands of young people camped on the streets of New Delhi. On July 20, [over 10,000 tried to march to Parliament](https://substack.com/redirect/62ab6add-3495-46c6-a1d9-de580ed75d8a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but were turned away as police fired tear gas and beat activists with batons. **150 protesters were wounded**. Multiple videos showed the police attacking marchers; no footage has emerged of any violence by the protesters. Opposition leader Rahul Gandhi was detained.
And then, unexpectedly, [the government blinked](https://substack.com/redirect/147a0647-2bc8-453b-8cba-cabd8a591335?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). On July 25, Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned. Given the Modi government rarely concedes anything, I found it significant that it agreed to all three of the CJP demands: (a) Pradhan's resignation; (b) no prosecution of protesters; and (c) compensation for families of students who died. [CNBC called it](https://substack.com/redirect/147a0647-2bc8-453b-8cba-cabd8a591335?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the moment India's Gen Z "forced Modi to listen, respond and act...exposing chinks in the ruling party's armor."
[](https://substack.com/redirect/87afe083-4c2f-42cf-adef-36b758876ec4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
It seems the cockroaches won. And the playbook was identical to every other Gen Z revolt on the list. Begin with social media organizing. Have a leaderless movement structure. Exhibit moral clarity and clear objectives. And have a willingness to endure resistance (including beatings in the street) until the government either cracks down harder or gives in. India's Chief Justice called them parasites. Around two months later, the education minister was forced to resign.
_The[ Journal of Democracy](https://substack.com/redirect/29922d62-676f-4076-aeef-983e4f9c6d82?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ warns that toppling a leader is the easy part. The harder question is whether any of this translates into lasting change. **Will the movements create jobs, affordable housing, or exams that aren 't rigged?** History suggests they probably won't, but this generation doesn't seem interested in waiting to find out. These battles will be long and drawn out but today's youth are resilient and determined. I wouldn't bet against them. After all, cockroaches are among nature's most accomplished survivors.

And with all the chaos going on, this election year is crucial, and it's going to take all of us fighting like hell to win. | | Right now, with all of the chaos coming out of Republican‐controlled Washington, we're stuck with a Senate in the GOP's hands ‐‐ and they're doing nothing but cutting our healthcare, cutting good‐paying jobs, and cutting billionaires' taxes. If we want that to change, then it's up to us to take care of business, because enough is enough: We need to take back the Senate. None of us can afford to sit back on the sidelines of this fight. All of us must do our part to defend all blue seats, especially in battleground states like Georgia and my home state of Michigan, and flip four red seats to win the Senate majority. The great news is, there are more than four states with vulnerable GOP opponents, and we have strong Democratic candidates in all of them ‐‐ that's multiple paths to the majority! Taking back power starts here and now ‐‐ with you! The best way to get involved and support Democrats running for Senate, including those doing the tough work of flipping seats in critical states, is by contributing to the DSCC. The DSCC is the only committee solely dedicated to electing Democrats to the Senate. We need your help to fight for the Senate. If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will be processed immediately. | | | | This midterm election will shape the future of our country. Now is when we have to dig deep, embrace the inner fighter within ourselves, and step up to make sure we all do everything we can ‐‐ ‐‐ to win back the Senate. The stakes are simply too high for us not to. Besides, think of how sweet that can of Vernors (or whatever your favorite pop is) will taste on Election Day when Democrats win. In solidarity, Big Gretch Gretchen Whitmer | | The DSCC is the only committee solely dedicated to supporting Democrats in the U.S. Senate, and our work relies on grassroots supporters like you. I’m running for re-election because I know there’s more work to do. Already we have:
* Signed into law the **_Payee Fraud Prevention Act_** _,_ to stop fraudulent activity that targets seniors, retirees, and people with disabilities.
* Passed into law the **_Housing Our Communities Act_** to fund affordable housing across the country and bring us closer to ensuring safe, affordable housing as a human right for all.
* Created the nation’s first water assistance and shutoff prevention program, **securing over $1.1 billion to stop water shutoffs** for people who can’t afford rising water bills — because access to clean water is a human right.
* Worked with the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau to change the lives of 15 million Americans by **removing $50 billion in medical debt from their credit reports**. Trump undid this progress but our fight is not over!
* **Brought home $68 million for projects across every community in my congressional district** , including over $7 million for home repair programs for seniors and flood victims, and over $20 million to remove and replace lead pipes and improve infrastructure.
* Started the **Mamas Caucus** , the **Get The Lead Out Caucus,** and the **People’s Environmental Justice Caucus** in Congress to fight for our families, remove lead from drinking water, end environmental racism, ensure health equity, and secure changes like universal childcare and paid leave.

And more! I’m grateful to be with you in the fight for a democracy and economy where we can all thrive.
Always fighting for you,
Rashida

My nickname in Congress is “Mama Bear” because I never back down from bullies and corporations that try to hurt our communities and profit off our pain.
I’m running for re-election to keep fighting in Congress to protect you and your family. For example, here are recent policies I’ve introduced to protect you from lead poisoning, data centers, corporate price-gouging, and economic abuse:
* The __**_No AI Data Centers on Federal Lands Act_** __ would permanently ban large AI data centers and related infrastructure on land owned or managed by the U.S. government. Our public lands are for us, not destructive and polluting data centers!
* The **_GET THE LEAD OUT Act_** and the **_Removing Existing Pipes with Lead and Advancing Clean Environments (REPLACE) Act_** , which I’m co-leading with Rep. Shontel Brown,**** would address the lead poisoning crisis by removing lead from drinking water and from our homes.
* The******_FAIR Credit Act_** _(Fostering Accuracy and Integrity in the Reporting of Credit)_ would restore credit for victims of predatory lending, fraud, and financial abuse — and ban medical debt from being included on credit reports. This expands opportunities for Americans whose credit scores have blocked them from accessing basic needs like housing.
* The** _Stop Price Gouging in Grocery Stores Act_** would prohibit stores from using cameras and your personal data to manipulate and raise food prices.

Thank you for taking action! It’s an honor to work for you in Congress.
My first bill signed into law was the **_Payee Fraud Prevention Act_** _,_ to stop fraudulent activity that targets seniors, retirees, and people with disabilities. **The**** _Housing Our Communities Act_** was my latest bill to become law — it will fund affordable housing across the country and bring us closer to ensuring safe, affordable housing as a human right for all.
I also created the nation’s first water assistance and shutoff prevention program, **securing over $1.1 billion to stop water shutoffs** for people who can’t afford rising water bills, and I’ve introduced the **_Water Access & Affordability Act _**to create the first permanent federal water affordability program.
And I passed the **_Restoring Communities Left Behind Act_** , which funds home repairs and neighborhood revitalization. Since I began in Congress in 2019, I’ve also **brought home $68 million for projects across every community in my congressional district** , including over $7 million for home repair programs for seniors and flood victims, and over $20 million to remove and replace lead pipes and improve infrastructure.
I’ve also worked with the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau to change the lives of 15 million Americans by **removing $50 billion in medical debt from their credit reports**. Trump undid this progress but our fight is not over!
In Congress, **I serve on the House Oversight Committee & Financial Services Committee **where I fight against Big Banks, the Trump administration, and corporations that profit off our pain.
I’ve also co-founded and I co-lead the **Get The Lead Out Caucus** and the **People’s Environmental Justice Caucus** in Congress,**** to build on the work we’ve started to guarantee everyone the right to drink clean water, breathe clean air, and live in a healthy environment.
And I’m supporting and leading legislation to put a nationwide moratorium on data centers’ expansion, erase medical debt and utility debt (including water bills), guarantee healthcare for all Americans, hold utilities and other for-profit corporations accountable, and end poverty.
I’m running for Congress again because I know we have more work to do together. And I’m grateful to be with you in the fight for a democracy and economy where we can all thrive.
Always serving you,
Rashida

The Stop Price Gouging in Grocery Stores Act would prohibit stores from using cameras and your personal data to manipulate and raise food prices. Thank you for taking action! And I passed the Restoring Communities Left Behind Act , which funds home repairs and neighborhood revitalization. Since I began in Congress in 2019, I’ve also brought home $68 million for projects across every community in my congressional district , including over $7 million for home repair programs for seniors and flood victims, and over $20 million to remove and replace lead pipes and improve infrastructure.
