The final 48 hours are here, friend. On Tuesday, Michigan voters will choose who will advance from the primaries to the general election. And in three districts, our endorsed climate champions have a real opportunity to win — _and take us one step closer to flipping the House in November._ But first, they need our help. **Trump carried Michigan in both 2024 and 2020, which means the naysayers aren’t expecting progressive, grassroots power to win on Tuesday. I know that voters are ready for change, but that comes down to how we close out these final 48 hours.** **[While you still can, I hope you’ll take this opportunity to split a donation between Donavan McKinney, running for Michigan’s 13th congressional district, Will Lawrence, running for Michigan’s 7th congressional district, and Erin Byrnes, running for State Senate District 2 >>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136477152/637591938/298873525?refcode=ea.148aac43-828e-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ms=ea.148aac43-828e-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjE0OGFhYzQzLTgyOGUtZjExMS1iMzM3LTAwMGQzYTE1NThjZSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=xD3A1bF6PvYudPCqMxDWNkDjTb3b-y7pQ4eZKNM-fB4=)** | [**SPLIT A DONATION →**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136477154/637591940/298873525?refcode=ea.148aac43-828e-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ms=ea.148aac43-828e-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjE0OGFhYzQzLTgyOGUtZjExMS1iMzM3LTAwMGQzYTE1NThjZSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=xD3A1bF6PvYudPCqMxDWNkDjTb3b-y7pQ4eZKNM-fB4=)

Donavan isn't pretending to understand what Detroit needs. He’s lived through the same struggles as his neighbors.
His grandmother has an asthmatic cough. His mother has it. His brother has it. Donavan has it, too. It’s far too common for anyone who grew up in the shadow of Detroit's factories.
Donavan is a three-time JanePAC candidate, and you can see why. In the state legislature, he secured $600 million to replace lead pipes, passed legislation protecting the Great Lakes, and sponsored a Ratepayer Bill of Rights to hold DTE, Michigan’s utility monopoly, accountable for gouging families.
**His opponent, on the other hand? Shri Thanedar voted to thank ICE as they terrorize our communities. His campaign is not powered by working people like Donavan’s is — it is propped up by a massive stock portfolio.**

Will’s climate activism began at age twelve, when he first learned about climate change, but it didn’t end there. He co-founded the Sunrise Movement and started the nation’s first campus fossil fuel divestment campaign while a student in college.
His coalition-building work for the Green New Deal has _already resulted_ in real policy outcomes, like portions of the Build Back Better plan and the Inflation Reduction Act. Will has even put his body on the line to protest pipeline projects. _(His arrest record actually looks a lot like mine!)_
**Super PACs have already spent more than $3 million trying to defeat Will. Because if he wins Tuesday’s primary and proceeds to the general election, he’ll have an opportunity to flip this toss-up seat from red to blue.**

clean_body: These are the kinds of leaders we need | The final 48 hours are here, friend. On Tuesday, Michigan voters will choose who will advance from the primaries to the general election. And in three districts, our endorsed climate champions have a real opportunity to win — and take us one step closer to flipping the House in November. But first, they need our help. Trump carried Michigan in both 2024 and 2020, which means the naysayers aren’t expecting progressive, grassroots power to win on Tuesday. I know that voters are ready for change, but that comes down to how we close out these final 48 hours. = | = = Donavan isn't pretending to understand what Detroit needs. He’s lived through the same struggles as his neighbors. His grandmother has an asthmatic cough. His mother has it. His brother has it. Donavan has it, too. It’s far too common for anyone who grew up in the shadow of Detroit's factories. Donavan is a three-time JanePAC candidate, and you can see why. In the state legislature, he secured $600 million to replace lead pipes, passed legislation protecting the Great Lakes, and sponsored a Ratepayer Bill of Rights to hold DTE, Michigan’s utility monopoly, accountable for gouging families. His opponent, on the other hand? Shri Thanedar voted to thank ICE as they terrorize our communities. His campaign is not powered by working people like Donavan’s is — it is propped up by a massive stock portfolio. = = Will’s climate activism began at age twelve, when he first learned about climate change, but it didn’t end there. He co-founded the Sunrise Movement and started the nation’s first campus fossil fuel divestment campaign while a student in college. His coalition-building work for the Green New Deal has already resulted in real policy outcomes, like portions of the Build Back Better plan and the Inflation Reduction Act. Will has even put his body on the line to protest pipeline projects. (His arrest record actually looks a lot like mine!) Super PACs have already spent more than $3 million trying to defeat Will. Because if he wins Tuesday’s primary and proceeds to the general election, he’ll have an opportunity to flip this toss-up seat from red to blue. = = Erin is running in a competitive primary for an open seat, and the stakes couldn't be higher. Newly drawn State Senate District 2 sits in the heart of Michigan's industrial corridor — auto plants, rail yards, freight, and the fugitive dust and asthma that come with them. Erin is a proven fighter against the utility giant DTE, and she's voted to block tax giveaways to power-hungry data centers. This is a safe Democratic district, so the winner of this primary is likely the winner of the general election, meaning August 4 decides who represents these frontline families for years to come. = = In solidarity, xx Jane = | Follow along: | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- Paid for with regulated funds by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, 600 Pennsylvania Ave SE, Unit 15180, Washington, DC 20003, authorized by erin Byrnes. Section 219 of the current House defense bill creates a permanent executive office inside the Pentagon with one job: accelerate US-Israel military integration. Not a pilot program. Not a time-limited review. A standing office with no ceiling, no sunset, and every incentive to keep expanding.
We're not talking about spare parts contracts. We're talking about artificial intelligence for the US military. Autonomous weapons. Cyber warfare. Intelligence systems that determine who gets flagged as a threat and who becomes a target. Six programs like that aren't interchangeable with six thousand bootlace orders. They can be the brain and nervous system of the entire machine for decades to come.
And this office -- according to policy analysts who've studied the bill -- outranks the Pentagon's own office responsible for blocking risky technology transfers. This, with a country our own intelligence agencies have flagged as the highest espionage threat level against America we have. Higher than many formal adversaries.
This is about sovereignty. When a co-developed targeting algorithm flags a human being for death, who determined why? Whose data trained it? Whose rules govern it? Who's accountable when it's wrong? That's not a procurement question. That's a question of who actually controls American military force.
And every dollar that flows into this arrangement -- open-ended, permanent, growing -- is a dollar Congress will tell you next year we don't have for your healthcare, your groceries, your infrastructure, your future.
My opponent, 30-year AIPAC-funded Congressman Adam Smith, co-sponsored this bill, pushed to advance it, and killed the amendment in his own committee that would have stripped it out. He was thanked by name publicly by Netanyahu for it. Then, under pressure from constituents -- and from millions of views on videos calling him out by name -- he said he'd changed his mind and would fight to remove it. Days later, on national television, he told the country it barely mattered.
He doesn't get to have it both ways. Either it mattered enough to reverse his position, or it was as small as he told the cameras. What actually changed? Not his convictions. His math. He didn't discover his spine in July. He discovered a primary challenge he couldn't wave off anymore.
Here's what we should all be demanding right now:
**1.** Strip the executive agent provision -- or give it its own recorded vote. Not a rider buried in a thousand-page bill.
**2.** Require frequent, public, independent audits of every AI and intelligence system this touches.
**3.** Prohibit American technology from ever supporting violations of the law. With teeth.
And here's who you can call today:
* Senate Majority Leader **John Thune** & Minority Leader **Chuck Schumer**
* Senate Armed Services Chair **Roger Wicker** & Ranking Member **Jack Reed**
* WA Senators **Patty Murray** & **Maria Cantwell** -- tell them we expect a fight, not a rubber stamp
* Already holding the line: **Bernie Sanders, Chris Van Hollen, Elizabeth Warren, Ed Markey, Jeff Merkley, Peter Welch** -- call and tell them to keep going
* House Speaker **Mike Johnson** & Armed Services Chair **Mike Rogers**

This is not over. Conference hasn't happened yet. Every call gets logged. Every call counts.
I'm Melissa Chaudhry, candidate for Congress in Washington's Ninth District. My father and my husband are decorated, disabled American veterans -- Navy and Army both. I have lived what war costs a family long after the uniform comes off. Subjecting our military to a foreign government is personally offensive to me, and I have the standing to fight it.
Unlike Adam Smith, I don't take defense contractor money. I don't take corporate PAC money. I don't take foreign interest money. I will fight for American sovereignty, constitutional war powers, and a real public debate -- before the switch gets flipped, not a press release after.
**Care. Courage. The Constitution.**

body:

| | Friend,
I clawed my way into this fight, fighting _twice_ as hard, earning every inch, and taking _nothing_ for granted. I’m not backing down now.

I wrote this note with you in mind, because everything I’ve done, every battle I’ve taken on, has only been possible because of supporters like you.

They told me I couldn’t do it.
Said I was too young. Too conservative. Too outspoken.

They wanted me to stay in my lane. Sit still. Smile pretty.
_**Well, bless their hearts. They had no idea who they were dealing with,**_**Friend _._**

I rolled up my sleeves, fought like hell, and shattered a glass ceiling as the first woman ever elected to the U.S. Senate from Alabama. I don’t just show up. I dig in, do the work, and refuse to be _outworked_ or _outmatched_.

Not because it was easy, but because this country is worth every ounce of the fight.

I didn’t grow up dreaming of power. I grew up in Enterprise, Alabama, where I learned the value of _faith_ , _family_ , and _hard work_. I’m a Christian, a wife, a mom, and a proud conservative. __And I ran for office because I couldn’t sit back while the Left tore apart**everything** we love_._
Now? I’m doing exactly what I promised:
---
|
---
**✅ _Calling out_ their lies.**
**✅ Fighting back against their _radical_ agenda.**
**✅ Defending our _values_ with everything I’ve got.**
|
---
But make no mistake, the Left is pouring _**millions**_ into flipping conservative seats. And trust me, _**_they’re furious mine isn’t up for grabs_.**_

So now? They’re setting their sights on _every one of my conservative friends_ and doing everything they can to crush our momentum, shut us up, and take down anyone who dares to stand in their way.

They want us gone. Quiet. Out of the way.
_**Too bad. I didn’t come here to make friends. I came here to clean house.**_

If you believe in what I’m fighting for, if you still believe this country is worth saving, then I need you with me. **[This is a grassroots fight, and it only works when people like you chip in. $5, $10, whatever you can give helps us hold the line and keep fighting like hell:](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)**
|
---
[CHIP IN ANY AMOUNT >>](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)

Because this isn’t just about me. This is about whether the America we love survives, or gets ripped apart by people who _mock our values_ , _trash our faith_ , and _couldn’t care less_ what it means to work hard, raise a family, or live with purpose.
I’m proud to have you standing with me.

\- Katie Britt

| | Here’s the deal: Shapiro is going to spend millions trying to define Stacy before Pennsylvanians get to know her. He’s going to use his massive war chest to flood the airwaves with attacks because he can’t run on his record.

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

clean_body: I need you with me in the home stretch! | Democrat Aly Richards is running for Governor to make Vermont a state where everyone can thrive. We hope to have you on our team, but if you want to opt out from future emails, you can . I wanted to quickly reach out and say: thank you, Peter. Thank you for helping our campaign hit our final end-of-month fundraising deadline before the primary. Thank you for volunteering to knock on doors, putting up lawn signs, and showing up to our campaign stops. Thank you for showing up for this grassroots campaign every time we’ve asked. Our movement wouldn’t be what it is without you, and I’m so grateful. I’m fighting for a Vermont where working families can actually afford to stay — where every Vermonter has a primary care provider, where young people have real pathways to good jobs right here in our state, and where we build enough housing to welcome new families and grow our communities. That’s the Vermont I know is possible, and that’s what this campaign has always been about. But with nine days left in this primary, we’re running out of time to show voters that I am the best candidate to defeat Phil Scott. Now more than ever, I need to know you’re with me in the home stretch. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = = = = = Vermont’s best days are still ahead. Let’s finish this together. \- Aly = | | Aly is running for governor because she knows Vermonters are hungry for change — not more of the same. Together, we will fix our broken health care system, build housing Vermonters can actually afford, protect our communities from the dysfunction in Washington, and create an economy that works for all of us. | = = Follow along: | | | ---|---|---|--- Aly for Vermont P.O. Box 91 Waterbury, VT 05676 Paid for by Aly for Vermont.

Friend: In a moment, I'm going to share with you my vision for New Mexico — **_[but first, can I ask you to take 30 seconds to personally endorse my campaign for Governor?](https://act.debhaaland.com/signup/em_mw_202608_endorse_vision?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&source=jtk1130-su-nd&refcode=jtk1130-su-nd&t=2&akid=11399%2E400544%2EJlmQ_o)_**
| | [Add My Name](https://act.debhaaland.com/signup/em_mw_202608_endorse_vision?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&source=jtk1130-su-nd&refcode=jtk1130-su-nd&t=3&akid=11399%2E400544%2EJlmQ_o)
---
This message is a bit on the longer side, but because you're invested in the future of New Mexico, I hope you'll take the time to read my plan. **As New Mexico’s next Governor, I will:**
**Build Education That Works for New Mexico by:**
* Ensuring students can read before third grade by identifying literacy challenges early and providing targeted support when children fall behind

* Strengthening early literacy screening, expanding bilingual and reading instruction, and investing in summer reading and after-school programs that reinforce learning beyond the school day

* Bolstering access to universal childcare, because learning begins long before a child enters a classroom

* Directing unspent dollars from the Public School Capital Outlay Fund to modernize and improve school facilities so kids can focus on learning

* Expanding outdoor and place-based learning through my Every Child Outdoor Initiative, giving schools the tools and resources to connect classroom instruction to real-world learning that improves engagement and outcomes

**Support New Mexico Families by:**
* Raising the minimum wage and eliminating predatory junk fees

* Passing Paid Family and Medical Leave so people don’t have to choose between caring for their family and making ends meet

* Increasing the child tax credit to put money back into your pockets

* Creating a statewide tenant bill of rights to make renting more affordable and more transparent

* Creating a Critical Sector Housing Fund for workers in critical sectors — like healthcare, behavioral health, social work, education, and more — to recruit more professionals to New Mexico to address endemic shortages that hold our people back

* Aggressively building more housing, eliminating unnecessary red tape, driving state investment into housing, and shortening the time it takes to build a home — and ensuring those homes are built with New Mexican labor

**Back Small Businesses by:**
* Establishing a permanent Office of Small Business to coordinate development programs, fill gaps left by federal cuts, and provide clear access to grants, capital, and state resources

* Cracking down on predatory lending by requiring full transparency in small-business loan disclosures

* Establishing a New Mexico Economic Growth Trust Fund to stabilize our economy in the face of federal uncertainty

**Fix Our Broken Healthcare System by:**
* Protecting and expanding access to healthcare in every part of New Mexico

* Banning medical debt from being included on credit reports

* Expanding New Mexico’s Health Care Affordability Fund to protect access for those who rely on the state marketplace

* Using budget surpluses to fill Medicaid gaps and hire more guides to help people enroll in and keep their benefits

* Ensuring sustainable funding for rural hospitals and clinics, expanding mobile health clinics, and significantly increasing access to outpatient behavioral and mental health care, including a full-scale effort to deliver mental health and homelessness assistance statewide

**Strengthen Public Safety by:**
* Ensuring that law enforcement has the tools, staffing, and technology they need to do their jobs effectively

* Investing in mental and behavioral healthcare and housing stability

* Expanding violence intervention and prevention programs in schools and communities, building accountability systems that emphasize fairness and trust, and investing in community policing models that supplement traditional police work

* Creating a statewide Department of Community Safety staffed with social workers and counselors so law enforcement can focus on violent crime while people get the help they need

* Requiring ICE agents to clearly identify themselves and prohibiting masks that shield misconduct from accountability

New Mexico deserves steady leadership that’s ready on day one, leadership rooted in firsthand knowledge and experience. But the only way we'll be able to make this vision a reality is with strong grassroots support from people like you.

Patriot, I typed and re-typed this message 5 or 6 times before hitting send... There’s so much to say, and it’s difficult to find all the words. I put everything into my last message - _**but it fell flat. **_ In a way, I feel like this is the text I'm being called me to send. So I’m trusting that these words will inspire you. Patriot, this is Rep. Brandon Gill and at 29 years old, I decided to run for Congress where I became the youngest House Republican. **[I never imagined that just a few years later, I’d be sending a final message like this one pleading for your help.](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckDGP3CAQhX8N7ljhAWNvQRFlZSnFpUxKC8OcdyQDFmBf7t9HrJQm5XWvePrmffP7bXmztFPcftqAxl205LJQ_TzQ2-gzvlJ9UglYil1AgOZi4gIW6ypduCjbeeO8ltCh6cdp0NMopeqeZhB-XIdJ6B6Uu98dAiq1gvarcLrXQ0em4cQkoNf9INUNhZD3yQ3-_j6M0gFT4jy8rVhuLsWC-bLtJsWYWkrx5lLodvOs9ShMfmMwM5gLujPj7YNiRt8aDOY12-hT5BvtO39PmVf8Y0sr24BHToEK1vSZTv6fOgaOgR8WGlvOubEzxY3JR80nMtBnDUt1TD6-__rB_wkx0DbUIxVqM5l89F02_vigfaeiR6bEFiztr_31i2-_DPwNAAD__3OSlUM)** You could say I prefer the simple things in life. I grew up on a cattle ranch and television isn’t my pastime. Being a husband and a father are the two most important things in my life. Sometimes, when I'm holding my kids I feel like I'm holding the whole world in my arms. **They are the wind in my sails when it comes to the mission I’ve committed my life & career to. ** And at the end of my life, I want to sit before the Father almighty and declare that I did all I could to leave this great country better off than it was when I grew up. _**[Nothing – I repeat – nothing is more important to me than fighting off the vicious leftist attacks against the soul of our country.](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckDGP3CAQhX8N7ljhAWNvQRFlZSnFpUxKC8OcdyQDFmBf7t9HrJQm5XWvePrmffP7bXmztFPcftqAxl205LJQ_TzQ2-gzvlJ9UglYil1AgOZi4gIW6ypduCjbeeO8ltCh6cdp0NMopeqeZhB-XIdJ6B6Uu98dAiq1gvarcLrXQ0em4cQkoNf9INUNhZD3yQ3-_j6M0gFT4jy8rVhuLsWC-bLtJsWYWkrx5lLodvOs9ShMfmMwM5gLujPj7YNiRt8aDOY12-hT5BvtO39PmVf8Y0sr24BHToEK1vSZTv6fOgaOgR8WGlvOubEzxY3JR80nMtBnDUt1TD6-__rB_wkx0DbUIxVqM5l89F02_vigfaeiR6bEFiztr_31i2-_DPwNAAD__3OSlUM)**_ The left hates you, they hate your vote, and they hate MAGA for putting America First. Patriot, today, I’ll make the same promise to you that I’ve made to myself, to my wife, and to my children. As long as I live, I will continue to FIGHT to preserve the soul of our country. No force on Earth will push me to abandon my mission and calling. Believe me, I’m not someone who finds it easy to ask for support. Texting you like this is the last thing I thought I’d have to do. But the country we love is on the brink of destruction & God has put it on my heart to fight with all that I have. _**[Please, will you take just 1 minute out of your busy schedule to help me continue my fight?](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckDGP3CAQhX8N7ljhAWNvQRFlZSnFpUxKC8OcdyQDFmBf7t9HrJQm5XWvePrmffP7bXmztFPcftqAxl205LJQ_TzQ2-gzvlJ9UglYil1AgOZi4gIW6ypduCjbeeO8ltCh6cdp0NMopeqeZhB-XIdJ6B6Uu98dAiq1gvarcLrXQ0em4cQkoNf9INUNhZD3yQ3-_j6M0gFT4jy8rVhuLsWC-bLtJsWYWkrx5lLodvOs9ShMfmMwM5gLujPj7YNiRt8aDOY12-hT5BvtO39PmVf8Y0sr24BHToEK1vSZTv6fOgaOgR8WGlvOubEzxY3JR80nMtBnDUt1TD6-__rB_wkx0DbUIxVqM5l89F02_vigfaeiR6bEFiztr_31i2-_DPwNAAD__3OSlUM)**_ This is more than a polite request. This is now a final plea for your support. Sincerely, Congressman Brandon Gill(R) TX-26

A Teacher of the Year. 27 years in the classroom. Caught in a child predator sting. This is why the fight cannot stop.

| [View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e6696711/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvY2J6cDZid1pjQQ/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA4MDI/LbmNsZ2tCU0czVw/qP2hpZHM9bmNwTEJTRXY4ZlF6TkVscw/gam9upg/s2r74e0707e)

| | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE
---
|
---
| | | Friend, He was trusted with the most precious thing in the world. _Other people's children._ For 27 years, Dennis Jutras walked the halls of Baltimore City schools. He taught history. He mentored students. In 2005, he was named **Teacher of the Year.** **Parents trusted him.** **Children****trusted him.** And then came the moment that revealed what was hiding beneath that trusted title.
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
**Jutras was recently arrested after sending graphic sexual messages and explicit photos to someone he believed was a 15-year-old boy, arranging to meet that child alone at a park.**
---
[ Help Protect God's Children Against Predators ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
But he did not meet a child. _He met law enforcement._ Thanks to a brave undercover detective and a sting operation organized by the Harford County Sheriff's Office, Jutras was taken into custody on the spot. He is now behind bars, held without bail. Friend, my name is Eduardo Verástegui. I produced the film _Sound of Freedom_ because I believe that exposing the evil of child exploitation is one of the most urgent callings of our time. And what happened in Baltimore is exactly why **the fight has never been more urgent.** Because this predator was not lurking in the shadows.
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
He was standing at the front of a classroom. He visited multiple schools every single day. **He had direct access to children** **And no one suspected a thing.** That is the terrifying truth about child exploitation that _Sound of Freedom_ tried to show the world: _evil does not always look like evil._ It hides behind titles. Behind smiling faces in school hallways. Behind trust. Sheriff Jeffrey Gahler said it plainly after the arrest: _"Someone's child, boy or girl, underage, is going to be criminally assaulted by these people if we're not out there intercepting them."_ **He is right.** And that is exactly why the **Sound of Freedom Foundation exists.**
---
[ Help Protect God's Children Against Predators ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
When you stand with us today, you are not just making a gift. You are saying that children deserve someone fighting for them. That the warning signs deserve to be exposed. **That trust should never be used as a weapon against the innocent.** Scripture calls us clearly: "_Defend the weak and the fatherless; uphold the cause of the poor and the oppressed. Rescue the weak and the needy; deliver them from the hand of the wicked_." (Psalm 82:3-4) **God sees every child.** And people like you, Friend, can answer that call. [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**[Will you make your first gift of $25, $50, $100, or whatever God places on your heart today?](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** When you give today, you are:
---
* Putting warning signs in front of families who need them
* Standing beside survivors who are still healing
* Carrying forward the mission the Sound of Freedom started

---
The Harford County Sheriff's Office and Chris Hansen did their part. Now it can be your turn. Join us and send a clear message to criminals like Dennis Jutras: **God's children are not for sale.**
---
With gratitude and prayer,
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Eduardo Verástegui
Sound of Freedom, Producer
For the Sound of Freedom Foundation
---

Your gift today helps make sure the Sound of Freedom Foundation can keep fighting against the predators hiding in plain sight. God's children deserve better. And with your help, we will fight to give it to them._

subject: Is the UN about to seize 400,000 acres of American soil?
body:
The only thing standing between the UN’s 400,000-acre power grab and American soil is one decision.
---
| | | | | |
---
| | | | | [View in browser](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTZ9AAwAAAAAAhsAuXu2y1B-fNPBxkANF-2NVKUkLLue9S2_n4t_-xN9OKGAowFteIXvUlYvQspT1bXx-YHZDay8SOv5CysNUf3v14Qfxgk5KI7qbvGLhw "View in Browser")
---
_**A Special Message from our Sponsor**_ _Please note that views expressed in this message do not necessarily reflect those of_ _Free Speech Daily_ _and do not constitute an endorsement or recommendation by Free Speech Daily_ _._
---
| *|MC_PREVIEW_TEXT|* | | | | [ ](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTZ9AAwAAAAAAhsAuXu3gf5GTCjQ5d5Rl2ZieMNGhdP6yXx0Piijt34DgeKesFBuYeDIa-dro1wwQr1R7dubRpN-95OfDRNs0uJRTObN5_HjQV-qkbTtxw)
---
| | Dear Fellow Patriot,

On July 19, a committee of 21 foreign governments gavels into session in Busan, South Korea – and somewhere in the days that follow, they’ll decide whether a 400,000-acre stretch of Georgia answers to them.

Not to Georgia. Not to America.

To _them_ – the United Nations.

And don’t kid yourself that it stops at one swamp. Hand the UN 400,000 acres of Georgia and you’ve handed them the precedent – the next piece of America comes easier, and the one after that easier still.

I’m Craig Rucker, President of CFACT – the Committee for a Constructive Tomorrow – and I want to give you a frank update on what the United Nations is actually up to right now.

Last weekend, you and I were lighting fireworks for America’s 250th birthday – a quarter of a millennium since a handful of farmers and shopkeepers told the most powerful empire on earth to take its crown and its tax collectors and pound sand.

**And now, before the smoke clears, the UN’s culture bureaucrats want to plant their flag in the Okefenokee Swamp.**

They don’t call it a flag, of course. They call it a “World Heritage Site” – a designation of “outstanding universal value.” (Translation: it’s not really yours anymore.)

The UN swears it would “only monitor” this swath of American land. (Right – the way a fox “only monitors” the henhouse.) Ask the folks in Charlton, Ware, and Clinch counties in Georgia what “monitor” means.

They’re the ones who’d wake up to find their hunting land, their timber, their own backyards redrawn as a “buffer zone” to “protect” a swamp that’s been doing just fine on its own since before there was a United Nations to mismanage it.

No hunting. No logging. No pulling weeds. No say. That’s the “universal value” on offer.

[**Will you please add your name to CFACT’s Declaration of Independence from the UN to tell President Trump and Interior Secretary Doug Burgum to pull this nomination off the table before the July 19 deadline**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTZ9AAwAAAAAAhsAuXu4EGV_G6V5yzLu9k_r_8tm5ery-MC_0Tt6DsY-hTUfLfTjbc-8thb369tFPbY_WA21f0Vy5WEYyYADStf1QgvPdgZfM4n1zmsZjg)?
[**Add My Name to the Declaration >>**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTZ9AAwAAAAAAhsAuXu5wqZwe9oq7iS1bSbzrwkMIDriWi-f63224RlwsNa9kg8W_b93L-MhTcL76lw-t7eYqZj3oM-0g6LrMAwcmv9n8j8evYSAGCRDZQ)
So how did we get here? A midnight gift in January 2025.

The Okefenokee sat on a UN “tentative list” for some 40 years, going nowhere – until the Biden administration, just before clearing out its desks, rammed through the nomination without so much as a phone call to the people who actually live there.

**A parting gift to the UN – from the same crew that spent four years handing out pieces of American sovereignty to anyone who asked.**

And the outfit advising the UN on whether to bless it?

The International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) – the global green bureaucracy whose own network brags about cramming climate “education” into the Paris accord that Trump already tore up.

This was never about alligators and peat moss. **It’s about handing a chunk of America to the climate agenda’s permanent government – the one nobody elected and nobody can fire.**

President Trump already walked America out of UNESCO – one of 66 international outfits he’s shown the door to, including the UN’s climate convention itself. Good.

But walking out of UNESCO alone doesn’t stop this.

**The nomination rides a separate track, and the United States is still bound to the “World Heritage Convention.”**

Which means unless Secretary Burgum formally rescinds it, those 21 foreign governments get the final word on American soil – whether we’re members of their little club or not.

One signature stands between the UN and the Okefenokee – Secretary Burgum’s, on an order pulling this nomination off the table. _That’s the whole fight, in a single stroke of a pen_.

This is exactly the fight CFACT was built for.

Our team went to Folkston, Georgia – cameras rolling – and sat down with the county commissioners the UN never bothered to consult, and put their warnings on the record while the national press looked the other way.

**We’re also one of the only conservative outfits holding official NGO observer status at the United Nations – which means when they convene, we have the standing to be in the room and fight them to their faces.**

That’s the difference between a think tank and a DO tank. And because we don’t take one dime of taxpayer money, there isn’t a globalist on this earth who can buy us off or shut us up.

_The good news?_ This fight is winnable, and the momentum is ours.

Three counties have already passed ordinances against it. When the UN’s own advisors held their little meeting down in Folkston, it did not go the way they planned.

America has walked away from UNESCO before – under Reagan, and again under Trump. The pattern is hard to miss: when Americans actually show up, the globalists lose.

So let’s show up.

[**Add your name to the Declaration today – and then chip in $25, $50, or $100 to keep CFACT’s boots on the ground for the next land grab, because there is always a next one**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTZ9AAwAAAAAAhsAuXu6w5IfYZxNS9y81OyCQ42oALuTiA4DrROlX5UlFCu7OFpoeUwKBH9DR66zEjT6xDGbhOUY7vNMvVRek9FieLKl1AEHGIM0KG4SHA).

Two hundred and fifty years ago, we declared our independence from a faraway power that thought it owned us.

It’s time to do it again.

For American sovereignty,

Craig Rucker
President

P.S. – Twenty-one foreign governments are about to vote on a piece of Georgia, fifteen days after we celebrate 250 years of telling distant powers exactly where to put their opinions about our land. [**Add your name before July 19 – and let’s make this Independence Day mean something**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTZ9AAwAAAAAAhsAuXu76-VAomi7AdexzFNbvS8Ga-3glFs_84m9FsHFe6xs6MwqbdLDXn-j2abBwPd7T9leiB0L8jEvWNZyuUSZxV2ETQda5ZXjYywSCQ).
[**Add My Name to the Declaration >>**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTZ9AAwAAAAAAhsAuXu88y8Cva0QO5KUmoXaXXiDt0YDfEcdDJKTLsiAxFvG73wpVREzG7CZ2VDti-95uz5Ybdp8HMLSznHd-LTVsglaa0_7Mn0SRbM5cg)

name: Wes Moore
subject: Saying goodbye
body:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1694%2E1086043%2ETtWW59)
This is a longer email about saying goodbye, Peter, but if you don’t have time to read through, I would deeply appreciate **[a contribution to power our campaign.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260802-1.xRJ9lk&refcode=em-20260802-1&t=2&akid=1694%2E1086043%2ETtWW59)**
After nearly a century of operation, Valley Forge Military Academy — the place where I went to school and grew from an angry, complicated child to a confident young man — has closed.
When my mother first sent me to the Forge, she saw military school as a last resort in response to a seemingly endless chain of misbehavior, both at home and at school. At age 11, I’d already felt handcuffs on my wrists. **I was not on a path to success.**
There was no overnight miracle when I started school there, but slowly, things changed. I learned about honor, code, and service. I started to take an interest in campus life, academics, and leadership positions — and I rose up the ranks and became a first captain in command of around 800 cadets.
After graduation, I went on to study at Johns Hopkins and Oxford, deployed to Afghanistan with the 82nd Airborne Division, ran one of the largest poverty-fighting organizations in the country, and now, I serve as the 63rd governor of Maryland _and the first Black governor in the history of my state._
What saddens me most isn’t losing a place I once called home. My memories will forever live on with me.
**It saddens me that other young men like me will have one fewer avenue to challenge themselves and build their own pathway to success.**
Peter, at a time where our young men and boys are falling behind and feeling isolated, we have to offer more paths for connection and engagement.
I know Valley Forge Military Academy did that for me, and I’m determined to find ways to do that for young Marylanders today.
That includes the **Maryland Corps and Service Year Option** — the first statewide program in the country to give high school graduates a year of paid, full-time community service on the path to college or a career.
We have to help young Marylanders find the thing that guides them on a pathway to success and that inspires them to serve. **[If you support that mission, I would appreciate a donation to keep me in the fight as Maryland's governor today.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260802-1.xRJ9lk&refcode=em-20260802-1&t=3&akid=1694%2E1086043%2ETtWW59)**
Elevate,
Wes

# [It Was an Honor to Stand With Lieutenant Governor Austin Davis in Blair County!](https://bethfarnhamforcongress.com/2026/08/02/it-was-an-honor-to-stand-with-lieutenant-governor-austin-davis-in-blair-county/?jetpack_skip_subscription_popup)
---
By **Elizabeth Farnham** on August 2, 2026
---
| **District Round-up 08.02.26**
---
Dear Neighbor, Thank you for reading my District Round-up. As your candidate for Pennsylvania’s 13th Congressional District, it is my honor and pleasure to deliver to you where I’ve been and what issues I’ve tackled in the past week. Criss-crossing the counties of Adams, Franklin, Fulton, Bedford, Cambria, Blair, Huntingdon, Mifflin, Juniata, Perry, Cumberland, and Somerset gives me great opportunities to meet with voters, hear what is on your hearts and minds, and the chance to voice my fight for Everyday Americans. If you would like to contribute to my campaign, please donate here:**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/beth-farnham-for-congress-1](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=619d345e07e85da0a205afaa7fc7ca1121d8ac320c63b609a792fc8bbdf7d114&blog_id=213069660&post_id=8424&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=9745e31dd5bbb851ce31e59e728ad03e&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2JldGgtZmFybmhhbS1mb3ItY29uZ3Jlc3MtMQ=&email_id=cbd85669ca00dda0cdb6572aaf690bf7)**
---
| **Standing with Lt. Governor Davis in Blair County!**
---
| |
---
It was an honor to stand with Lieutenant Governor Davis and fellow candidates Sean Steeg for State Senate, Caleb McCoy for PA House79, and Sarah Holland for PA House 80, as well as with newly-elected Blair County Democratic Committee Chair McCailey Flaugh last Sunday in Duncansville, Blair County.
---
Lieutenant Governor Davis introduced his beautiful family and spoke of his and Shapiro’s accomplishments over the past four years like investing more in public education than ever before, hiring hundreds of new law enforcement officers, creating thousands of new jobs, and putting money back in people’s pockets.
---
I especially appreciate how these leaders have stood up to Trump by refusing to release private data from the voter rolls and the names of poll workers. Moreover, they just sued the Trump Administration over its illegal effort to hold millions of critical homeland security dollars hostage in another attempt to control Pennsylvania’s elections.
---
In the future, they’ll do even more for Pennsylvanians.
---
I hope you join me in voting for these gentlemen, as well as all other Democrats down the ballot, including me.
---
Together, we #ChooseDemocracy !
---
| |
---|---
| **PLEASE CALL YOUR SENATORS!**
---
| |
---
How are our Voting Rights on the line?
---
Because the U.S. House of Representatives voted to pass the FY 2027 Reconciliation (Budget) bill which provides $60 billion for defense spending, $13 billion for intelligence operations, $12 billion for farmer relief, and $10 billion for the SAVE Act.
---
Even though U.S. citizens already prove their citizenship to the states where they register to vote, the SAVE Act is requiring further proof of citizenship for any change of address, name, party, or if one was kicked off the voter roles for not voting often enough, re-registration.
---
And in Pennsylvania, the Real I.D. doesn’t provide that proof of citizenship. Only 5 states have the kind of I.D. that does prove citizenship, but Pennsylvania isn’t one of them.
---
Instead, Pennsylvania residents, especially people whose names don’t match those on their birth certificates, including married women who took the name of their spouse, will need to use a current passport to prove their citizenship.
---
Passports cost $165, fyi.
---
In related news, there isn’t massive voter fraud like the Trump administration disingenuously claims to justify this curtailing of women’s agency.
---

I want to tell you something that’s not easy to talk about...
A sitting Republican elected official recently tagged the Department of Homeland Security on social media and wrote: "I would like to report a foreign occupier. Name: Unpronounceable. Country of origin: Tatooine." He was talking about me. The same official called for the mass deportation of Indian Americans.
I was born in New Delhi. I came to this country as a baby. I grew up in Peoria, Illinois. I went to public schools, got on food stamps for a time with my family, worked my way to Princeton and Harvard Law. I served in government. I got elected to Congress four times.
And someone still looked at all of that and saw a foreign occupier.
I'm telling you this not for sympathy. I'm telling you this because what happened to me is happening to communities all across this country right now, at a scale we have never seen before.
Trump and his MAGA allies have made it clear: if you weren't born here, if your name is hard to pronounce, if you look different or pray differently, you are not fully American in their eyes. They are using the machinery of the federal government to make that point, loudly and cruelly, every single day.
My father came here with nothing. He believed this country would be there for families like ours. It was. Barely. Because people fought for it.
That is exactly why I started Equal Opportunity Now.
We need leaders in office who will stand up for immigrant families and for every community that Trump has decided to make an enemy.
Those leaders exist. They are running for office right now. They need our support.
Will you chip in $25 or $50 today to help Equal Opportunity Now back the leaders who won't back down? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]

It’s on us to stop the rising tide of MAGA Extremism. And with your help? We’ll be unstoppable.
— Raja Krishnamoorthi

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Here's a story I'll never forget, once I learned the truth behind it.

In 1917, a small group of revolutionaries led by Vladimir Lenin seized power in Russia. They promised a better, fairer world...sound familiar?

But soon after taking control, they began rounding up and executing anyone who stood in their way. Lenin even ordered his followers to hang landowners and seize their crops--so that for miles around, "people see, and tremble..."

Marxism began with promises of a perfect world--and ended in fear, famine, and death.

You may be familiar with that dark history, but too many Americans aren't. How do I know?

Because a century later, these dangerous ideas have been repackaged and rebranded. They're taught in schools and promoted by celebrity politicians using words such as "equity," "diversity," and "social justice."

The words sound harmless, but the ideas behind them are the same. Will they end up with the same terrifying results?

| | Peter, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, _**[please let me tell you why it’s so critical.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=ecec5755dfd344deb91e45e34fed412f&_e=CLIZRpI8W5oEGZRWjuTVNx_z0mjQXwgbmOwaDE92paw9FmRdQe9dgAMqg2ALgGklSAMZ2jOCAshSAKwJFamKfJbcQSDHxR5FyTEP6ALuBnvCEP26JbjoR6k89vY-SQ5xBci_Mv0FseGM16-tcpPV7-DagaoTJWXUBRnwZmQFGwQfo4Es-_z4VaxZGzb7itu_ed1iKq2h4TUpfbP6X3zBlyeGfBeEFLKuY6x4_LcfT5dqendT7dPRf7AEPOY8bbVf1ej6d3rfeW8Q4StJ6kgySv8VKrLepRWxCp7bi1jciKB9PJZ6b4UgJMLrYk5tFtwn4VGy3SqGBxYmCvgDU_ho2E42CHH12sxk7xgto4agFtyzL-I2e-hQYoeqXDtC0Ha1wnxF9SRdnnYL6o5RtjL9bkzVXdagtECgfSosbTqUiR9JrVK3feeKXzSNFwXAp__gJcJ37M8KFeDJ3zDXx1vLkqG22Xx9hehAsGC2R6zkRgZqyieeCEqAYptVMiaZb7yafHSCHmm3krtZdcV3ygSf3--T_iNxzBjUqA5AQdWsEqJrv2_VnuVzoPC_jmJ7LSZL3Qj-uluRZjzabzRdvU7bkQYF9hHLrscVCozuvr0cC-UAqTrxJJ1xftOYYOLr84FJ7vQ3qIPqv6Dt3MenVMubvlY-lkk82xznvUiZlzn2MkFU7Vj62l6DbRvV0Q5TYgZiw3HnL3jwbOOc06l37BryDLNNo6LEjVwbleZmRjIsYuc%3D)**_ Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_.But today, all that has changed. Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call _Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ _Little House_ series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... _A is for Activist._ An _ABC_ _board_ _book_ for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” _Woke Baby_. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” _Prince and Knight._ The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And _The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish._ A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.”I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...

| | _**[That’s why parents and grandparents across the country are rising up through See You At The Library Day.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=ecec5755dfd344deb91e45e34fed412f&_e=CLIZRpI8W5oEGZRWjuTVNx_z0mjQXwgbmOwaDE92paw9FmRdQe9dgAMqg2ALgGklSAMZ2jOCAshSAKwJFamKfJbcQSDHxR5FyTEP6ALuBnvCEP26JbjoR6k89vY-SQ5xBci_Mv0FseGM16-tcpPV7-DagaoTJWXUBRnwZmQFGwQfo4Es-_z4VaxZGzb7itu_ed1iKq2h4TUpfbP6X3zBlyeGfBeEFLKuY6x4_LcfT5dqendT7dPRf7AEPOY8bbVfx8KN65Fmlv92pU8NA8i8RVpSBohnuDijjcxIwOmqVEShAYCtxvQh2S4kmXKj5ZQVO-6p_-x8VnaASfrlGYuay-Zy9gt7JqHaOpiMOtAbPcq9hmLM_CobKCfB3tuWyrngAMFvflBP1HtI6U84xDp0WTZ8lH30N0x8GJymGdtGWhh80AUpGyWjqxsXriLAJ9Ym75bjfEwCT2ap-tvBTM8qQwApCE9fbOHy59G0mQ-ClK6De6kNEm-hB9gHVX3mE4KrUMs88Jks-JgM8X1dWWJeoFYhGEVFxm9Pv1T5BbzEccYD6UpzBn-F0XspgjgLgtcbd0eJn6rX9QEa8isD2JGJqXqklBjlUBJ0-QvHMGdEFouEuBFMLSwg58r3bGjG9KTmHShTT-45GyKJDWv0K2Km_TvkeA4htprFvz9voZlg4Tf7Z5HbispQG3E0f3nbY4_GfCszsvzKm59qqC-Z8zThr3zZb1UXgDAptJ1gjDGMUPg%3D)**_ For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA.And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content.Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family -- for now.But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of _other_ children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values!_**[I hope you see why I need your help today.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=ecec5755dfd344deb91e45e34fed412f&_e=CLIZRpI8W5oEGZRWjuTVNx_z0mjQXwgbmOwaDE92paw9FmRdQe9dgAMqg2ALgGklSAMZ2jOCAshSAKwJFamKfJbcQSDHxR5FyTEP6ALuBnvCEP26JbjoR6k89vY-SQ5xBci_Mv0FseGM16-tcpPV7-DagaoTJWXUBRnwZmQFGwQfo4Es-_z4VaxZGzb7itu_ed1iKq2h4TUpfbP6X3zBlyeGfBeEFLKuY6x4_LcfT5dqendT7dPRf7AEPOY8bbVf4-kv7nPIsD0S2IEoL6HYsLSUx4EcAPNJ_B0B1-47TaOnCOWs_NPpgcK-s2i4H4Vh5haOkn3U20Y9e2AKbON8YGVzCtzuTVoz3tpU0QJjYcIVwoRUa633XO7-Bo-eex6qH8LVYyNsTEl1tJWHWoZXLJc0vSLu3sLqZxbUUEFbmofKfH6pF9RT6oT76CcVeg5g896Z0e2rKCn5MNPwMTBS8GfCHLiPWS3HLgSDkHNAQvH9GAG7XSNP77UzoaIe-XQE6D7aCG85vwSD4ttH8xUOMPgdRadt9DLFjaWFrzep20PULfrVMlSD5fkS4xDZH6Ib2DoRF-A-CGr47Y-Z4Bf7OoiWsVUgy8nqnEOqz8t8Ujb0TFWBAOYz-FFdhDNMkiHdtM0aY6ahF5oDqIR4AagvIxDBh--HFYj6uOSQI5IeFoIQ9Ma4g5d5BbayI9NMYw722WIUV9l4C6B2G84Ft8B_QP6wi4daNtjOQ5Jxhat_NlE%3D) **_My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with _conservative Story Hours_ filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that onebit.>> Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.>> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on.I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those “Story Hours” where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America”, and read wholesome and Godly books.It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part...From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could host “Story Hours” of their own.And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement was born.Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours”filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a very simple mission -- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. _**[And this year, honoring America’s 250th birthday, my ambitious goal is to expand “See You at the Library Day” to reach 250,000 children.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=ecec5755dfd344deb91e45e34fed412f&_e=CLIZRpI8W5oEGZRWjuTVNx_z0mjQXwgbmOwaDE92paw9FmRdQe9dgAMqg2ALgGklSAMZ2jOCAshSAKwJFamKfJbcQSDHxR5FyTEP6ALuBnvCEP26JbjoR6k89vY-SQ5xBci_Mv0FseGM16-tcpPV7-DagaoTJWXUBRnwZmQFGwQfo4Es-_z4VaxZGzb7itu_ed1iKq2h4TUpfbP6X3zBlyeGfBeEFLKuY6x4_LcfT5dqendT7dPRf7AEPOY8bbVfFiPLI-YBtUXLOFCkCf4pTe10ZmcLWLJmP_1IYuauMln9Wj7A4ggiQ3bZP5OBmwiJAA0lW0_5wv3jFy-mPnboSdBHXmHrfv_68Ewd2M0QZn1uCLxajvZV0F4Wy-TDPnIyfWsgQnPS8IyAACNyX_qqLH5-jyHXIDI7lA5Kx_-C0z06D2c0EVgMt5ZhhwZjJclq9mU3ONaIZ1oLIOaPxM8hoq6Q-pnlv8S3KntZ6mqhX70gxQMPcGXi14ZUD8_ZR0XhCEDPy5GCPJhjzwsm3aebQCASGzvsGO2wr65aQIZJaIZv3VEJ4T9uRMyrc8Al-F4cijmqjQnmOQSvBJgncARvOKZBtqtEMdGTLPBdGKbx7fmb2WIqzHrfJbQ9-X1gNJnyA6m6sumNACqjWtluNOphjJNnEy1dUZ1aUiAVtyz65OV4ebdhD7aGmiK0sBWv-DfsEEfhavxfplniIEr3l6xKZ9eHwktpIdRXZUOfHakK0ig%3D)**_ The exact date will soon be announced. And before then, I need you! The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host “Story Hours” has been overwhelming.That’s a very good thing.But it’s going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold “Story Hours” for 250,000 children. _**[That’s why I’ve teamed with a very special non-profit called BRAVE for Good to make this year’s “See You at the Library Day” a bigger success than ever.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=ecec5755dfd344deb91e45e34fed412f&_e=CLIZRpI8W5oEGZRWjuTVNx_z0mjQXwgbmOwaDE92paw9FmRdQe9dgAMqg2ALgGklSAMZ2jOCAshSAKwJFamKfJbcQSDHxR5FyTEP6ALuBnvCEP26JbjoR6k89vY-SQ5xBci_Mv0FseGM16-tcpPV7-DagaoTJWXUBRnwZmQFGwQfo4Es-_z4VaxZGzb7itu_ed1iKq2h4TUpfbP6X3zBlyeGfBeEFLKuY6x4_LcfT5dqendT7dPRf7AEPOY8bbVf3JGgLu_F2ZWCXOcN2P7gEIZn6XVxI8hgQbEG6iGKW0WVO27HLNKdPgb86YkTkftN4MyKjdYlCh6mLhElfqzrSwmTjS-aUB1UGYMQTayj1XtBLzA68oFiS5EqIEFU0Z5-KdrBmAGyOsz9PI-81EN6sQ0qdXMRDCgEYsSSM56lU91pAzLhosCjkOY2hVrKDRaibKTyXzcO5pC0CsZ7fLuEFaVPf9Y4dkNAJXhmjRwFELj5tpU_32ZExbycPPPjXqmR_vjpIl-ExnJJ2f2y3AD92V-RSaQ-77OmHwkVf5ub0YmaJ-DPFTi89nzhoQpTgGKsi_8v3khyxWvXeP7RQ0bfl8ZyBAH5hXOZV0NzKls_P3uIgp7cFajHhcq0gbCZ61f4XzE9C6fSb7dEmzzftZ-7qHc09yvp7q0eSxNnvMk9nJ8dDjqWTxf6BLiojCZ9b4I4p8lwat3dCdDpNIr8o2IDJ1UIa2846HC2_X-Ti5KtXcw%3D)**_ **BRAVE for Good** was started by BRAVE Books -- the small Christian publisher of my book “As You Grow” –- because so many patriots were asking how they could help “See You at the Library Day” with a tax-deductible gift.Your sponsorship gift helps send a ‘Story Hour Kit’ to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library” event. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our “Story Hours” for 250,000 children to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries.We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. _**[Knowing that, please consider a sponsorship gift of $125. That’s enough to sponsor one entire ‘Story Hour Kit’ yourself.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=ecec5755dfd344deb91e45e34fed412f&_e=CLIZRpI8W5oEGZRWjuTVNx_z0mjQXwgbmOwaDE92paw9FmRdQe9dgAMqg2ALgGklSAMZ2jOCAshSAKwJFamKfJbcQSDHxR5FyTEP6ALuBnvCEP26JbjoR6k89vY-SQ5xBci_Mv0FseGM16-tcpPV7-DagaoTJWXUBRnwZmQFGwQfo4Es-_z4VaxZGzb7itu_ed1iKq2h4TUpfbP6X3zBlyeGfBeEFLKuY6x4_LcfT5dqendT7dPRf7AEPOY8bbVfSS9TruJQGsTz1aBXEEuHeEQ6D-wIyFWt1e2APdeAwLWqf7_nLD0VJhztYLUCY7kvETfRGklKYtu9oMgVNRJCL1w_ZwH9szCI6NgsPMRMvW0l0rT5VBpQ3OL9Mmb4WFkWjCSNegzdXcXkTKK6miM-6HSPf9REwgjht3OKQII4LA_03gPlkcm7XyuQo_SttFKGQncz9XAks6UMkDavycm8WmGpUMlYLJq13H95B9tlza5OrwqNjs-G8hqEhUVZqpBrWPePPYqX6yV64dYzxV8lE-_rd3oJBDGyXwGMRQN3w9bykjxwigRKLS94zfMj6RrPCJi24q9javppflNFV2_4NZVSHnYc8b97XTXKf_ZRkpXDqyzyzONMy2d2K0MJNK46mLd-K_NIMLyQXE8RfwNZm7rJO_-3Q_d755XGaSLUk64Je4eEyzzW5bpDLqZVtLbhjLfXg7NMJ99F11TAqvItxzZi5In87l0yoPgFND__wrU%3D)**_ Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. clean_body: Take back the libraries| | | | If you haven’t heard about the “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, please let me tell you why it’s so critical. | | Peter, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like Pat the Bunny and The Little Engine That Could. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the Three Musketeers , Treasure Island and Charlotte’s Web.But today, all that has changed. Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call Adventures of Huckleberry Finn and To Kill a Mockingbird “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ Little House series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... A is for Activist. An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” Woke Baby. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” Prince and Knight. The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish. A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.”I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco... | | | | ...but that’s just not true.<\- this is a man leading “drag queen story hour.”< p style="box-sizing: border-box;"> | | For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA.And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content.Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: Rick about a cross-dressing Grandpa, Melissa filled with graphic nudity, and Darkstalker featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family -- for now.But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values! My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with conservative Story Hours filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that onebit.>> Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.>> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on.I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those “Story Hours” where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America”, and read wholesome and Godly books.It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part...From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could host “Story Hours” of their own.And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement was born.Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours”filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a very simple mission -- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. The exact date will soon be announced. And before then, I need you! The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host “Story Hours” has been overwhelming.That’s a very good thing.But it’s going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold “Story Hours” for 250,000 children. BRAVE for Good was started by BRAVE Books -- the small Christian publisher of my book “As You Grow” –- because so many patriots were asking how they could help “See You at the Library Day” with a tax-deductible gift.Your sponsorship gift helps send a ‘Story Hour Kit’ to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library” event. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our “Story Hours” for 250,000 children to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries.We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. Whatever you can give whether it’s $35, $125, or anything higher or lower please send in your sponsorship gift in the next 48 hours so we know how many libraries we have sponsored for this year’s “See You at the Library Day.” Thank you! God Bless You and God Bless America, Kirk Cameron | | | BRAVE For Good 100 I-45 N 260Conroe, TX 77301 | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com

Axios: Dominion Voting sold to company run by ex-GOP election official [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/Axios_DominionVotingSale.png]
Axios broke news that Dominion Voting Systems — makers of voting machines used in 27 states for elections across the country — has been sold to a Missouri-based company run by a former Republican election official.
Scott Leiendecker is the owner of KNOWiNK, which is changing its corporate name to "Liberty Vote", and has previously been appointed by Missouri officials to investigate the 2000 election and be " St. Louis' Republican election director ."
Leiendecker told Axios in a statement that his company is " committed to delivering election technology that prioritizes paper-based transparency, security and simplicity so that voters can be assured that every ballot is filled-in accurately and fairly counted ."

Peter, it's Dinesh D'Souza.

I want to share something deeply personal with you today. Something I've never said quite this way before.

**The night before I was set to be locked away, I made a decision that changed everything about how I fight and how I've fought ever since.**

I'm not going to bury the lead: _**what I learned in that moment is the same thing I believe every patriot in this movement needs to hear right now. **_

Because what we're facing today is a threat to everything we've built — it can feel like the walls are closing in.

I know that feeling.

**And what I learned on the other side of it is something I've passed on to only a handful of people I trust most, including my son-in-law Brandon Gill who took it to Dartmouth, then took it to Washington, and uses it every single day to expose and dismantle the radical left in ways they never saw coming!**

[_**I'm sharing it with you now because I think you need it.**_](http://links.conservativeum.com/s/c/HiPcRLjK-NLLD2uGXbxolydIWVABEiI69AsW479CM2vZK0nVhlWROuqRNEJHgTWc99Ic_5WKTP2uwcbNFjOGa7ShdwtaSVdCknvpYMh7TWVQuETFNWIAb0DHz1oqa_IpQvXyZEfydA2Ff4t73Ha5yFEOU4iYi_Ht6duJbn15CBI_2WV8LgYfr3O97km9Di0CrUN6XskhOEyM7uklbwjHTPc5O4iCWBjikdf2WpZITGRGG56JYBmyjkDs8j2V60AHJ3uBJdxp-MEaEqW6h7glXrfsetWmjeSsd3hakdxAS92sSF1klmJKxqpTw1IWulwC3LSnc1kTUfoWMi3Hs6FaBzmlo9xzdYRaf0sp1k4FyHaeHmJ2LVi9jnnvA0Enc9wYk0lWr9cxyfLIgQnzA7ue9gcXZXnX-ZcUiaRCbL13dAQK8H1-BpIZFAK-tcAJ3cmeIR8tLqs8HC2GwdYb2EY0Wbo6lIoAwJsMX_tkUvLFDigi7S69_SYxsiR_X22OnnL7lhxXpEXg6rls3DKRZlPkc4Qelfg8n8M-gyVGIFNLlVDvZJVhBvErSHHRpj4ViHOtmahFjEiO3t8re9Tbcj_IiWnKzOcP6tZG0HyDG6ONpWCNCIId0exREzk8-YiD0Vjf0PUTIk-O7miEBLCHcQIOQ4cJdgtW9wwhqoTVGH8m7EcWYceTQ-ogAwguA1T_WBZK7VU9RgyevWqyE1GEug64MPUcyE5fdw4Kb1jafZwJuqFpxuFbjLFzI-4qsXHPtBv2jwvYPmTA1INwZSL1afefr4KMYn6o-eBlfR5J0v7UGEo5kHw/3lr0KRwofHZxZryfA_7DOhNNaj8EGm5V/23)

Don’t look at this as another fundraising pitch or one of those doomsday warnings.

I hope this will instead give you a genuine glimmer of hope about what we're up against — and exactly how we're going to win.

Lately, it's easy to feel discouraged by what we're seeing in the world around us, but here's something I believe with everything I have: **People get stronger when they come together in difficult times and refuse to let those challenges define what 's possible.**
It shouldn't just be who you vote for on Election Day, but a fight every day. Whether it's town halls or conversations in diners that don't make the news, it's the quiet, unglamorous work that counts. We are building a campaign from the ground up because the people of this district, and hundreds of others, deserve better than what they've been getting.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/08ba9aa8-937d-4006-b74b-cbdf6f86e0b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

**And it 's working because people like you are part of it. My name is Mike Cortese, and I am coming down on a primary election in 3 days. I need your help to hit our weekly goal today. If we receive just 20 donations of $20, we'd hit our goal. **
**!! ️** _**[Please](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/a69784c9-489c-481f-a4af-390e9fb897c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_**[j](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/a69784c9-489c-481f-a4af-390e9fb897c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** _**[oin us today](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/a69784c9-489c-481f-a4af-390e9fb897c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) !!️**_
[CHIP IN $20 HERE.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/a69784c9-489c-481f-a4af-390e9fb897c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
This campaign has been built dollar by dollar, conversation by conversation, county by county. There's been NO corporate shortcuts or PAC money smoothing the path fo our fight, just Americans who are tired of watching their government work for everyone except them deciding to do something about it.
**You don 't have to live in Tennessee to be part of this fight.** When a grassroots campaign beats a 14-year incumbent backed by corporate money, it proves something the establishment desperately doesn't want proven: that the people can still win.
**Be part of that proof.**_Democracy needs you in the game._

Fellow Patriot,

After the sudden death of my brother, Lindsey Graham, I was appointed by Governor Henry McMaster to represent South Carolina in the United States Senate.

**President Trump encouraged me to consider running in the Special Election by saying, "Run, Darline, Run!" Now, with the President's _"Complete and Total Endorsement," I'm running to represent South Carolina for a full term in the United States Senate._**

I've spent a lot of time talking and praying with my family. This was not a decision I made lightly. I know it will be difficult, _**but I am ready.**_

I know what Lindsey cared about, and we shared the same conservative values. He cared deeply about the people of South Carolina. With what I learned from Lindsey and my nearly 30 years of helping people of the state find dignity through work, I am ready to take on this next challenge.

It's time for me to step up for South Carolina, just like Lindsey stepped up for me when our parents died. I've learned God often calls on ordinary people to do extraordinary things in the most challenging of times.

I am not Lindsey. I have my own way of doing things. But we were raised with the same values: work hard each day, trust in the Lord, remember your roots, and never forget who you work for.

I am ready to continue his legacy. | Fellow Patriot, After the sudden death of my brother, Lindsey Graham, I was appointed by Governor Henry McMaster to represent South Carolina in the United States Senate. President Trump encouraged me to consider running in the Special Election by saying, "Run, Darline, Run!" Now, with the President's "Complete and Total Endorsement," I'm running to represent South Carolina for a full term in the United States Senate. I've spent a lot of time talking and praying with my family. This was not a decision I made lightly. I know it will be difficult, but I am ready. I know what Lindsey cared about, and we shared the same conservative values. He cared deeply about the people of South Carolina. With what I learned from Lindsey and my nearly 30 years of helping people of the state find dignity through work, I am ready to take on this next challenge. It's time for me to step up for South Carolina, just like Lindsey stepped up for me when our parents died. I've learned God often calls on ordinary people to do extraordinary things in the most challenging of times. I am not Lindsey. I have my own way of doing things. But we were raised with the same values: work hard each day, trust in the Lord, remember your roots, and never forget who you work for. I did not seek this moment, Fellow Patriot. But after many prayers and speaking with my family, I know I am making the right decision to run for this seat. I'll be straight with you - I am behind financially. My opponents are self-funding millionaires or have spent years building up their campaign war chests, but I'm new to politics. We have less than 2 weeks to run against people who have been at this for years. Since you were there for Lindsey, Thank you for everything you did for Lindsey over the years. subject: No paper, no vote
