Dear Peter, It’s clear that Americans want change. The system we have is not working. But if the SAVE Act passes, it could cut millions of Americans off from one of our most basic tools for creating change: **the simple and powerful act of voting.** **The SAVE Act is Trump’s latest attack on voting rights and democracy.** If passed, it would force tens of millions of Americans to produce a passport or birth certificate just to register to vote or update their voter registration – documents that millions of eligible citizens don't have on hand, and many can’t even afford. **[We still have time to kill this bill. Can you send a message to your senators today demanding they stop the SAVE America Act, once and for all?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39NmOvaZcBPP9JnPfijpf5t4Diu24AX0fFvXiYpNlfbhz0933sQt-HaFxaah7cxEtWcIhJPxXLzIdrL_7C1ydNlyzZ8xbXTyWniEKVvcpBWlAgrVSATrYj1hRrP_q53JMFsUkvg3JcdQvN5yav0e9r6u1rOFMoRumF83XpUVMcG_TnCcncWxQxFtwu4gf1cdcq-UDOQjKrRnppevN2Y3VHnaxdiXtKG9KFs6boKwjYVcYefKFUt78csMnzIldDPAiRpHMiVhOg0AGNGTf5Bs3cNm4exrAbPAmjq1m63y7qq82vCq__VFg6LWWAzFgjamq2U-mmDjC_-pCKxpG1Yvvdaemhm3uWKOAfRbCzQwSjRLE_FK5WmHXdzaZusXA7LCL3wsE9s_dR8QzHDktlIXr7FHmME2rcMCZLum01KSQ-glzYnexQ6TLk87O4sITlZIyXdgDI3nfT2TY_i61PgiH2l/4su/hhtw4s0nRpKlTN_B_10knQ/h0/h001.U7zsPNzvxwV3pQ9C4mJONo5UonDX9qNGI5c-FQaOc2o)** The SAVE Act would disenfranchise millions of Americans. Married women whose names changed. Young voters. Rural voters. People who moved. _If you can't produce the paper, you don't get to vote._ **But not voting is exactly the point.** Those in power want to shrink the electorate ahead of the midterms, because they know that Americans are ready to elect leaders who will serve them, not corporate interests. **The SAVE Act is just one tactic in a systematic attack on our voting rights.** The Supreme Court, built by dark money to serve dark money, just gutted the Voting Rights Act with its _Callais_ decision. And by placing Trump above the law, SCOTUS gave Trump a free pass to do whatever he wants without fear of consequences– _including trying to take away your right to cast a ballot against him and his MAGA buddies._ Trump is getting increasingly desperate to pass the SAVE Act. In fact, he just pressured Senate Majority Leader John Thune into canceling the Senate’s August break in order to pass the bill. **Where there’s urgency, there is fear.** Trump and his cronies know that the American people have power. We always have. Time and time again, we’ve fought back and won. In the courts, in the streets, and at the polls. _They understand that the power to vote is the power to create change, which is why they are in such a rush to take it away._ **[The Senate can still kill this bill. clean_body: | | Dear Peter, It’s clear that Americans want change. The system we have is not working. But if the SAVE Act passes, it could cut millions of Americans off from one of our most basic tools for creating change: the simple and powerful act of voting. The SAVE Act is Trump’s latest attack on voting rights and democracy. If passed, it would force tens of millions of Americans to produce a passport or birth certificate just to register to vote or update their voter registration – documents that millions of eligible citizens don't have on hand, and many can’t even afford. The SAVE Act would disenfranchise millions of Americans. Married women whose names changed. Young voters. Rural voters. People who moved. If you can't produce the paper, you don't get to vote. But not voting is exactly the point. Those in power want to shrink the electorate ahead of the midterms, because they know that Americans are ready to elect leaders who will serve them, not corporate interests. The SAVE Act is just one tactic in a systematic attack on our voting rights. The Supreme Court, built by dark money to serve dark money, just gutted the Voting Rights Act with its Callais decision. And by placing Trump above the law, SCOTUS gave Trump a free pass to do whatever he wants without fear of consequences– including trying to take away your right to cast a ballot against him and his MAGA buddies. Trump is getting increasingly desperate to pass the SAVE Act. In fact, he just pressured Senate Majority Leader John Thune into canceling the Senate’s August break in order to pass the bill. Where there’s urgency, there is fear. Trump and his cronies know that the American people have power. We always have. Time and time again, we’ve fought back and won. In the courts, in the streets, and at the polls. They understand that the power to vote is the power to create change, which is why they are in such a rush to take it away. Morgan Stahr United for Democracy Paid for by United for Democracy. | | Sent via . I was recently on the road in Michigan and Minnesota, where I campaigned with Dr. Abdul El-Sayed and Lieutenant Governor Peggy Flanagan. In each of these states, crypto billionaires, AI, Big Pharma, AIPAC, and Super PACs are flooding these Senate races with money because they're afraid. They’re afraid of not having Senators in office who will vote with their interests in mind. They’re afraid because Abdul and Peggy want to pass Medicare for All and get Big Money out of politics. They’re afraid of losing the status quo where Washington works for them. Campaign spending in each of these primaries has reached record-high levels. These two races are just days away — and we need to do everything we can to ensure Abdul and Peggy have the resources they need to compete against this onslaught of outside spending and dark money ads against them. [**So will you donate today to fight back? Every dollar you give will be split to support Peggy Flanagan in Minnesota, Dr. Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan, and our movement to take on the billionaires and special interests trying to buy our democracy**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3720?t=8&akid=2976%2E4032634%2El3ZdKL)

I LOVE YOU!](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=209253445&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjA5MjUzNDQ1LCJpYXQiOjE3ODU2OTczMjAsImV4cCI6MTc4ODI4OTMyMCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.Goymt5qfKHCzpXid0ApRuJ2jtZfSuEz7gWxrbTTrMcU)
### A message from Bailey, the official campaign dog of Haley Stevens for U.S. Senate!
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Aug 2
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/bailey-the-campaign-pup-woof-i-love?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email-restack-comment&action=restack-comment&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjA5MjUzNDQ1LCJpYXQiOjE3ODU2OTczMjAsImV4cCI6MTc4ODI4OTMyMCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.Goymt5qfKHCzpXid0ApRuJ2jtZfSuEz7gWxrbTTrMcU&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/bailey-the-campaign-pup-woof-i-love?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

WOOF!! HI, HUMAN!! 🐾 It's your best girl here, Bailey!!
I'm the official campaign dog for Haley Stevens, certified good girl, professional napper, coney dog-tasting expert, and emotional support animal to the entire Team Haley pack.
I have to say, there is something WILD happening at headquarters right now. **The humans keep telling each other the primary is in TWO DAYS.** I do not know what that means. I think it has to do with voting, which dogs cannot do (yet).
But the energy here is weird. It's like, I am trying to get my normal 15 to 16 hours of sleep, and the vibes are sorta squirrel-like. Meaning everybody is running around and barely taking a long break to pet me and snuggle me. Weird. Because I'm adorable and I love them.
THERE ARE SO MANY PEOPLE HERE. Humans I have never met before are coming in, and they sit down at tables with phones and lists. They go out into the Michigan sun. They talk about meeting voters. They smile and laugh, and they eat coney dogs standing up. Sometimes they sneak me little bits (and I have to say this personal gift is amazing, and I am accepting it with grace).
My mom is a literal angel. Katelyn - Haley's finance director - has not sat down in furever. She keeps saying, "Two days. We need support these next two days." Everyone keeps saying it. TWO DAYS. TWO DAYS. Ugh.
I do not know how long two days is. I am a dog._Is that one nap? Is it forty naps?_ Nobody will tell me, and frankly, I don't think they know either.
But here's the thing. The vibes right now are intense - but happy? Human people are complicated. Everyone is filled with joy but also kinda anxious. I'm like, PICK A LANE, HUMAN!
So in my official position as campaign dog, I want to get human-level serious for a second.
I LOVE everyone on this campaign. And I'm so proud of them. I've been under the desk and at the events and all over the place for all of it. I've seen Haley at events with hundreds of people, and she talks to every single one of them like they're the only person in the room. That's literally her favorite thing - talking to Michiganders. (I prefer sniffing, but whatever.) I can tell, Haley LOOOVES people almost as much as I do.
And they love her, humans. I can smell it. I would not lie to you about this because I am a dog. I don't know how to lie.
Haley works so hard. AND she always has time to give me pets. Honestly, her hustle makes me tired, and I have twice as many legs.
So I guess what I'm saying is that on Tuesday, the humans of Michigan get to decide if she wins the primary and gets closer to going to the Senate. TUESDAY. That's what we're running toward.
So here's what my mom says we need in these last two days:
They need to talk to as many Michiganders as they can before Tuesday. Calls, texts, doors, all of it. And doing that takes human dollars (aka money), which I don't understand at all, but on behalf of the people I love: If you're able to chip in before Tuesday, this would be a PAWS-itively perfect moment. Like, if you could give $10 or $1,000, that would be great. I think? I'm not sure. I don't have a good concept of how much that is.

ALSO! My queen of a mom keeps telling people this, and I'm going to tell you so she gives me a treat: **If you 're a Michigander, VOTE ON TUESDAY.**

We need to talk about data centers.
My opponent Jon Husted has been called the face of data centers in Ohio. He aggressively recruited them to Ohio and gave them huge tax breaks, while electricity bills exploded for ordinary residents.
**Me? I think these companies should pay for their own damn electricity.**
You may have seen my TV ad about this, and I want to tell you more below. **_[But if you've already heard enough, and you believe Ohio families should come before data centers, chip in now to help me defeat Jon Husted and fight back against corporate interests:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136499770/637640699/-1037742479?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk5679-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YmViMDYxMC1hNThlLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xReDj9nJkFkOIvuB-76hXNbgExcK5hjQfnWl3qiwyl8=)_**

The fact is, data centers draw a ton of electricity from the grid. That demand drives up costs across the whole system, and right now, that cost gets passed along to regular folks. That's why Ohio families are seeing higher electric bills.
Jon Husted doesn't care that Ohioans are footing the bill. Instead, he fast-tracked approvals for data centers and cut them sweetheart tax deals, while working people struggled to afford gas and groceries.

When he was asked about it, Husted said Ohioans should look in the mirror, that "we are the problem." He said if folks don't like data centers, they can "go back to the bunny ear antenna" on their TVs and stop using digital products.

I find that mindset infuriating. Husted is blaming you. He doesn’t seem to think the ultrawealthy tech companies driving up your bill have anything to do with it.
**That tells you everything about who Jon Husted works for. And who he's fighting for.**

My position is simpler. Data centers should pay the full cost of the electricity they use. That's it. That's the whole idea. Ohio families shouldn't pay more on their energy bills so big corporations can protect their profits.

That's not radical. That's basic fairness.

And it's the key difference between Jon Husted and me. When the choice comes down to a corporation's profits or a family's budget, he picks the corporation every time.

I pick working families. Every time.

clean_body: | | | = We need to talk about data centers. My opponent Jon Husted has been called the face of data centers in Ohio. He aggressively recruited them to Ohio and gave them huge tax breaks, while electricity bills exploded for ordinary residents. Me? I think these companies should pay for their own damn electricity. You may have seen my TV ad about this, and I want to tell you more below. = | | = The fact is, data centers draw a ton of electricity from the grid. That demand drives up costs across the whole system, and right now, that cost gets passed along to regular folks. That's why Ohio families are seeing higher electric bills. Jon Husted doesn't care that Ohioans are footing the bill. Instead, he fast-tracked approvals for data centers and cut them sweetheart tax deals, while working people struggled to afford gas and groceries. When he was asked about it, Husted said Ohioans should look in the mirror, that "we are the problem." He said if folks don't like data centers, they can "go back to the bunny ear antenna" on their TVs and stop using digital products. I find that mindset infuriating. Husted is blaming you. He doesn’t seem to think the ultrawealthy tech companies driving up your bill have anything to do with it. That tells you everything about who Jon Husted works for. And who he's fighting for. My position is simpler. Data centers should pay the full cost of the electricity they use. That's it. That's the whole idea. Ohio families shouldn't pay more on their energy bills so big corporations can protect their profits. That's not radical. That's basic fairness. And it's the key difference between Jon Husted and me. When the choice comes down to a corporation's profits or a family's budget, he picks the corporation every time. I pick working families. Every time. But I can only keep fighting if I flip this battleground seat. National Republicans, Elon Musk, and their corporate special interests are spending over $130 million to stop us. = | | = In solidarity, Sherrod | | Note: This email only reflects donations made online with this email address. If you've made a previous contribution via check or with a different email address/phone number, you may not see it here – but know that Sherrod and our entire team are deeply grateful for your support. = Hey there! It's Sherrod Brown. There's nobody fighting for Ohioans in the U.S. Senate right now, and I won't sit on the sidelines while working people get screwed over by large corporations and wealthy political donors. If you work hard, you should be able to afford a decent life. But the reality is, life is too expensive. Costs are going up. Wages are staying stagnant. Working people are working harder than ever before, and they're not getting their share of the profit. This campaign is all about changing that – and election analysts say we have a strong shot at winning in November. But I'll need your help to pull it off: My opponent is a Washington insider being propped up by the Republican establishment, and he's got virtually unlimited resources. That's not how our campaign works. We're a grassroots movement, and that means we rely on ordinary people chipping in a couple bucks. = If you'd like to receive exclusive updates from my team, you can text "OHIO" to 64054. Thank you. | | = | | = | If you'd like to receive fewer emails, please . | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. 🚨SENATE BATTLEGROUND UPDATE: New Hampshire is now the closest
Democratic-held Senate race in the country.🚨

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260802_1.xhRQvB&refcode=em20260802-1&t=1003&akid=8082%2E582294%2E_V3Qza ]Help flip the Senate by rushing a donation to Chris Pappas today »

It’s Chris
Pappas.

The latest ratings from Sabato’s Crystal Ball have named New Hampshire the
most competitive Democratic-held Senate race in the country. This isn’t a
surprise — we’ve known this would be one of the closest races since we
began this campaign.

Recent polling has us only one point ahead of John Sununu, and national
Republicans and their dark money allies have been running attack ads
against me around the clock.

And it’s working. While Senate races like Georgia’s are shifting toward
Democrats, New Hampshire’s is stuck in a dead heat. We’re still in one of
the most competitive races in the country — and now the UVA Center for
Politics rates us the most likely Democratic Senate seat to flip this
fall.

We have to protect this seat to have any chance of stopping the GOP’s
extreme agenda and flipping the Senate. But I can’t do it without your
support.

With less than 100 days until Election Day, the polls tied, and our rating
as the most likely to flip, this could be the moment that decides the

Bitcoin Was the Prototype
Say what you want about Bitcoin — it proved something the experts swore was impossible.

It proved that millions of people want a way to store wealth that no government can print, freeze, or inflate away. That idea was radical in 2009. Today it's a trillion-dollar fact.

But here's what the true believers don't like to admit: Bitcoin got the idea right and the backing wrong.

It's backed by nothing but belief. It can lose a third of its value in a month. And it consumes as much electricity as a small country just to keep the lights on.

It was the prototype. A brilliant, world-changing prototype — but a prototype all the same.

So here's the question worth sitting with: what happens when someone takes everything Bitcoin got right — the digital freedom, the scarcity, the independence from any government — and fixes the one thing it got wrong, by backing it with real, verified gold?

You get the finished version. And it starts trading on Kraken today (July 8).

And to be clear: this isn't another speculative crypto, and it isn't paper gold. It's backed by real, certified, in-ground gold — the gold stays right where it is, and the value trades.

I'm not going to unpack the whole thing in an email. But I've been watching it closely, it's cleared one of the toughest exchanges in the world, and I put together the full briefing on what it is.

Get to the good, green grass first...

subject: Tom Perriello has spent decades building movements for justice
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
I need your help to give Tom’s campaign a big, grassroots boost as he launches the general election sprint toward victory this November.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260802-6547-footer&t=1&akid=6547%2E420207%2EjOrdwb)
Peter,
Tuesday is a big day for our progressive movement, both here in Washington and around the country. In Virginia, my friend Tom Perriello is fighting to reclaim Virginia’s Fifth District.
**Tom has spent decades building movements for justice** — from leading advocacy organizations that fight to raise wages, protect civil rights and liberties, and advance bold economic policies, to working as a peace negotiator and prosecutor of war crimes. I’ve worked closely with him on human rights efforts in Sudan, where he has been a steadfast advocate for peace, accountability, and civilian leadership.
Tom understands that our progressive values cross boundaries — and he’s done that work both abroad and right here at home. He refuses corporate PAC contributions because he won’t be beholden to the billionaires and giant corporations. He’s staunchly for Medicare for All, because he knows it’s past time for guaranteed universal healthcare for everyone, rather than a for-profit sick-care system. He’s going to be my partner in Congress in fighting for working people and poor people across this country to thrive, not just barely survive.
**That’s the kind of fighter I want with me in Congress. That’s the kind of fearless ally I need in our new majority to pass Medicare for All, fight for working families here at home, and help build a more just and peaceful world.**
So today, I need your help to give Tom’s campaign a big, grassroots boost as he launches the general election sprint toward victory this November.
[**This is the moment to show the growing strength of our progressive movement, which is why I’m asking you to join me in supporting Tom by splitting a donation between our campaigns today.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260801-3.0gfWbk&refcode=em20260802-6547&t=2&akid=6547%2E420207%2EjOrdwb)

Together, we can keep growing our progressive movement and build a government — and a foreign policy — that reflects our values of justice, democracy, human dignity, and opportunity for all.
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20260802-6547-footer&t=22&refcode2=6547_420207_jOrdwb&akid=6547%2E420207%2EjOrdwb)**

Team, my friends over at Resist Reclaim Rebuild said I could reach out:
I'm honored to share that I have officially become the Democratic nominee for Congress in NY-21.
I am grateful for everyone who has believed that a dairy farmer from the North Country could build something strong enough to compete in one of the most important races in the country.
When we launched back in December of 2024, I didn't do it because I wanted to be a politician. I did it because I love this community, and I believe the people here deserve someone who knows their struggles, because they've lived them too.
Over the last year, I've traveled this district, met with families, listened to workers, farmers, parents, veterans, and small business owners.
Everywhere I went, I heard the same thing: people are tired of being forgotten.
That's what brought us here.
But this isn't the finish line. It's the beginning of the next chapter.
The eyes of the country are turning toward NY-21. More money will enter this race. More attention will follow. The fight ahead won't be easy.
But I've never been afraid of hard work.
On the farm, you don't stop working because you've finished one job. You get up the next morning and start the next one.
That's exactly what we're going to do.
Will you split a donation of $25—or whatever you can afford— between my campaign and Resist Reclaim Rebuild to become a Founding Donor of our General Election campaign right now? Your early support is the fuel we need to build a winning infrastructure, hire organizers, and ensure our message reaches every corner of NY-21. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-blake]

body:
I want you to hear me on this

Derek, some politicians love to talk a big game about freedom. Folks like my opponent love to claim that _their_ idea of freedom rules above all else. But hear me on this: It’s not freedom when the far-right tries to tell us what books our children can and can’t read. It’s not freedom when the government tells women what they can and cannot do with their bodies. And it sure as hell isn’t freedom when families here in Pennsylvania and all across the country are paying more, all so Donald Trump’s friends can pay less. **Here in Pennsylvania, we’re about real freedom.** The freedom to get ahead. The freedom to choose. The freedom to be safe and feel safe. The freedom to provide for your family. **That’s what this campaign is all about.** [**Derek, can I count on you to chip in just a few dollars to help me keep protecting real freedom here in Pennsylvania? clean_body: As we speak, too many kids in classrooms across the country are being taught that America's Founders were villains. | | | | August 02, 2026 | | Sunday, August 2, 2026 | Estimated Read Time: 3 Minutes Just The Truth Your No-BS Newsletter Dear Readers, Today's sponsor, Defending Education, is offering supporters a copy of its Founders' Almanac on Education with a qualifying donation to help promote what it describes as a strong, non-political approach to education rooted in the principles of America's Founding Fathers. Thank you for your consideration of our sponsors. The Just The Truth Team , As we speak, too many kids in classrooms across the country are being taught that America's Founders were villains. Not the architects of the most successful experiment in self-government the world has ever seen. Not even as flawed men navigating an imperfect world. Villains. That's not education. That's indoctrination, and it's happening while we're supposed to be celebrating America's 250th birthday. John Adams, Thomas Jefferson, and George Washington didn't see education as a box to check. They saw it as what made self-government possible in the first place. Knowledge, character, and citizenship all tied together. That's what built this country. And that's exactly what activist administrators are working overtime to erase... Defending Education is not going to let them rewrite America's founding without a fight. That's why we put together the Founders' Almanac on Education — a resource that lays out, in the Founders' own words , what they actually believed education was for. This booklet serves as a reminder of what education looked like at the time of America's birth and how the nation's founders believed the citizenry should be educated. This ties in perfectly with our mission. Defending Education is fighting for a strong, non-political, high-quality education system. A system that gives your kids real knowledge, real character, and the tools they need to become good citizens.Over the past five years, we have: Exposed thousands of incidents of indoctrination in schools Built a database of 21,314 schools with parental exclusion policies Identified over 700 school districts with Sanctuary Schools and Closed Borders Resolutions and Policies Filed legal cases and administrative complaints challenging unlawful practices (and won!) body:
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136500923/637644891/-49673432?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2NkODI0ODQtYWU4ZS1mMTExLWIzMzctMDAwZDNhMTU1OGNlIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Odaa5qF33CM-bH4mwMaUPoW1FK54arMS4rHXRDHIczI=) Friend, _17 years._ That’s how long it’s been since we’ve last increased the federal minimum wage. That's the longest stretch without an increase since the minimum wage was created – _88 years ago._ And this whole time, prices have only kept going up. $7.25 an hour today buys less than $5 did back then. clean_body: When Democratic pro-choice women lead at the state and local level, we all win. | = There's no doubt about it, Peter: All eyes are on Michigan this election cycle. But today, we're not talking about Michigan’s races for Congress. We're spotlighting Dr. Theresa Brooks , an EMILYs List-endorsed candidate running to flip Michigan's 9th state Senate District. Theresa's competitive Democratic primary is this Tuesday. With early voting already underway, she's counting on us to help deliver one final surge of support. = | = As a physician, small business owner, and current Troy City Council member, Theresa has spent her career fighting to keep Michigan families safe and healthy. She's seen firsthand how rising healthcare costs are burdening the families she serves. In the state Senate, Theresa will fight to expand access to quality, affordable care, lower prescription drug prices, and reduce the cost of child care and senior care. State and local races may not always dominate the national headlines, but the leaders we elect at this level make decisions that directly affect our families and communities. They can also provide a crucial check on the Trump administration and its dangerous policies. That's why we launched our State Power Plan this year: a bold strategy to secure governing power across nine key states, including Michigan. When Democratic pro-choice women lead, we all win. How I stack up against the competition.

# Why Vote for Me?
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |

[](https://us.list-manage.com/oz3LVZcvg2y?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a)

I’ll be sending you daily e-mails from now through the primary election day on Tuesday, so I’ll keep this short.
I’ve been putting together some very clear, very succinct final campaign messages to send out to voters, particularly through social media and on YouTube, headed into Tuesday. I’ve been hearing that there is low turnout so far for early voting in the congressional primaries, and I’m not sure whether that will help me or hurt me. But it does mean there are a lot of people who will be tuning in at the last minute to get a sense of who I am and a brief case for why they should vote for me.
See three videos that I’ve posted and promoted.
The first is built around my go-to one liner: “I think the US Congress is a good idea, and it would be nice if we had one.” I’ve been doing a lot of canvassing and talking to voters on the street, and it’s a sign of the times that whenever I say this, everyone immediately knows what I’m talking about.
Here it is [on Facebook](https://us.list-manage.com/PIpJMxvplD2?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a), and here it is [on YouTube](https://us.list-manage.com/Cs2Yi2J1zoO?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a). Spread it around.
In the [second video](https://us.list-manage.com/EGkB85seOGs?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a), I compare myself to the other Democratic candidates, emphasizing the fact that I have a "specific, focused message and agenda” that is about the “need to reclaim the power of Congress,” and that “[I’ve got a plan](https://us.list-manage.com/EKsClEMTLM6?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a)for how to reassert that power.”

Here it is [on Facebook](https://us.list-manage.com/1BDHxKYW0Ol?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a), and here it is [on YouTube](https://us.list-manage.com/RpkoblulRb4?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a).
Finally, I have [a pitch](https://us.list-manage.com/8_hYUaS4is7?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a)aimed partly at Independent voters and disgruntled Republicans who might be considering asking for a Democratic ballot on Tuesday. Virginia is, after all, an open primary state. I warn them that Republicans have built Frankenstein’s monster: an all-powerful presidency which could be used by people they really don’t agree with. “I am running to limit presidential power, to limit this unchecked power, to bring power back to Congress. And I’m willing to limit even the power of a future Democratic president. I’m willing to do that because that way we can limit Donald Trump's power now—and we can also limit the power of whoever comes after him. We can think forward and realize that no one person should have this much power.”

Here it is [on Facebook](https://us.list-manage.com/17rWcP0H5SC?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a), and here it is [on YouTube](https://us.list-manage.com/12_9uRpxwcb?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a).
Again, spread these far and wide. When canvassing yesterday, I encountered some people who had already voted—and many others who were at most vaguely aware that there was a primary coming up. People need the reminder of when and where it is, and who’s running.
Also, if you like what I’m saying, support my campaign. This is your **last chance** to help out before the primary this Tuesday, so please donate **now**.

---
| [DONATE TO HELP ME GET THIS IMPORTANT MESSAGE OUT](https://us.list-manage.com/12pOTNdYSPY?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a)
---
| |

### Who Is Rob Tracinski?

I also want to remind you of what I think is the best [pre-primary profile](https://us.list-manage.com/OhNbguyO8yz?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a) of me, in _Cville Right Now_ : “I’m doing this purely because I didn’t want to see our democracy go without a fight. And so I’m here to accomplish some key things to put the American system back together and make it function again. And then I’m going to be very happy to return home to a peaceful life.’”

Help me get this message out by[ donating with ActBlue](https://us.list-manage.com/187zBUFWKff?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a). Even $100 or $200 can make a difference, especially in these crucial final days of the primary.

body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136501289/637645931/1538324755?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZDkwYTAwMi1iNDhlLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eEqwzK1Q1Id7VtyD3RTqhbQgo7434PxTWf8XkkRxK0U=) Peter, When I came back to Oregon after graduate school, I took a job at Oregon Food Bank. I was drawn to their mission to end hunger, not just feed people. It was a great fit for me and helped me to build my skills as an advocate for others. At the Capitol in Salem and across the state, I fought for solutions that would help people not have to seek out emergency food assistance – supporting strong minimum wage, affordable housing, and access to health insurance. The people I met and heard from along the way have been my guiding light ever since. That work led me to run for public office and serve in the Oregon Legislature. In my first term, I rewrote the state’s anti-poverty program for low-income families while also securing historic protections for the LGBTQ+ community. Later, when I became Speaker of the House, we raised the minimum wage and passed paid family leave. And as Governor, when Trump tried to strip SNAP benefits from 750,000 Oregonians, I declared a hunger emergency, moved emergency funds to food banks, and my team worked through the night after the courts restored benefits to ensure the money hit people’s accounts by morning. [**That’s what leadership looks like: showing up, solving problems, and making sure Oregon families don’t go hungry.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136501290/637645932/1856876585?refcode=email_080226_opinion&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZDkwYTAwMi1iNDhlLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eEqwzK1Q1Id7VtyD3RTqhbQgo7434PxTWf8XkkRxK0U=&emci=7ab8fb9d-748b-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=7d90a002-b48e-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=15353729) [**But leadership starts with listening — and that’s why I want to hear from you. clean_body: I am ready to win this Special Election, but I need your help. | Fellow Patriot, With less than two weeks to go, The legacy my brother, Lindsey, built can never be replicated, but I can honor him by working as hard as he did, every single day, for the people of South Carolina. President Trump encouraged me to run in the upcoming Senate Special Election by saying: "Run, Darline, Run!" That endorsement isn't just an honor. It's a call to action. The President knows South Carolina needs a fighter who will finish what my brother started, and he's counting on us to deliver. I intend to earn every vote because that's what this job demands, and that's what South Carolina deserves. But here's the truth: My opponents are self-funding millionaires or have spent years stockpiling campaign cash. I'm new to this. The Special Election Primary is August 11th - just 9 days away. Every dollar raised between now and then determines whether we can compete on the airwaves, get out the vote, and win. There is no "catching up later." This is the moment. President Trump believes in this campaign. Thank you, Darline Graham United States Senator (R-SC) | | Paid for by Darline for Senate Don't want to receive any more of our emails? | | Here in the South, now that the Supreme Court has greenlit racist new voting maps, we’re up against a full-on, coordinated, Neo-Confederate effort to rip representation away from Black and brown voters and cement one-party rule for the GOP. It’s a five-alarm fire. But Black leaders have warned that our region isn’t getting the resources and attention it needs: POLITICO:“Black lawmakers and activists across the Deep South argue they have been abandoned by the Democratic Party to fight an existential crisis on their own. They say they’ve been let down by nearly all corners of the party: would be-presidential hopefuls who have flocked to early and swing states but don’t bring their megaphones elsewhere; congressional leadership focused on majority-making battlegrounds while safe Black seats are drawn out; and years of chronic underfunding that has allowed local party apparatus to wither away.” [No matter what, Fair Fight will never abandon the South. It’s where we were founded, and it’s where we’ll stay — fighting voter suppression, promoting voter education, pushing back against disinformation, electing Democracy Champions, and powering a movement for free and fair elections. It’s a five-alarm fire. But Black leaders have warned that our region isn’t getting the resources and attention it needs: POLITICO:“Black lawmakers and activists across the Deep South argue they have been abandoned by the Democratic Party to fight an existential crisis on their own. They say they’ve been let down by nearly all corners of the party: would be-presidential hopefuls who have flocked to early and swing states but don’t bring their megaphones elsewhere; congressional leadership focused on majority-making battlegrounds while safe Black seats are drawn out; and years of chronic underfunding that has allowed local party apparatus to wither away.” = We got our start in Georgia, where it took years of grassroots organizing and sustained investments to mobilize a new electorate and make the Peach State one of the most competitive battlegrounds in the country. Team, Thank you for showing up for Fight Like Hell PAC during our end-of-month push. I’m incredibly grateful to have this grassroots team in the fight with us. Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Team
The Constitution places the authority to run elections squarely with the states and Congress – NOT with the federal government.
But the President keeps issuing executive orders imposing sweeping new federal controls over election administration.
Make no mistake, Team, these are more unlawful attempts by this MAGA administration to sow confusion and distrust ahead of the fall midterm elections.
We're doing everything in our power to fight back and protect the right to vote , including:
➜ Registering eligible voters
➜ Putting election information directly in the hands of voters
➜ Combating election misinformation
➜ Advocating at every level to keep our elections truly free and fair
Team, it will take massive resources to stand up to these Executive Orders in time to make a difference before the midterm elections. We need your help ASAP: Will you chip in $35 or whatever you can afford right now? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=080226_2&amount=35]

The most recent executive order purports to address “non-citizen voting.”
States, however, already have proven systems in place to verify voter eligibility, non-citizen voting is already a federal crime, and instances are vanishingly rare.
Rather than solving a real problem, this order manufactures one to justify granting this administration unprecedented authority over a process which the Constitution clearly delegates to the states and to Congress.
It's simple: These executive orders are dangerous, unlawful, and harmful to voters.
We will never stay silent when the right to vote is attacked, Team, including by a hostile administration in control of the federal government.
If you’re with us, please chip in $35 or whatever you can to fuel our work empowering voters ahead of the 2026 elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=080226_2&amount=35]

It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

We look forward to seeing you on the course!

* Reagan was known as the "Great Communicator" for presenting an optimistic vision of America.

Peter,
We hit our end-of-month goal, and I wanted to say thank you for everything. It's no surprise that our supporters showed up to crush our goals in the final deadline before the primary election.
**_With our primary just 4 days away_** , our campaign is firing on all cylinders to turn out the vote so we can return our focus and efforts on flipping this seat and defeating Andy Ogles at the ballot box this November.
Today, I'm not going to bug you for a single penny. But I am going to ask that if you're in TN-5, you show up to vote if you haven't yet. That you bring a friend. That you tell a neighbor. — Chaz

One Nation, a Republican dark money group, announced that they’re reserving $28 million in ads to target our campaign. My opponent is on the air already. **But here’s the thing -- most of that avalanche of money hasn’t even made it to the airwaves yet.**
This is just the beginning, and we’re about to be pummeled by millions more.
**We need to build up our own reserves so that we can respond when the bulk of their money lands.**
**[Will you split $5 today between my campaign and Wes Moore to help us match what’s coming?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260802-2.uHTqkV&refcode=em-20260802-2&t=2&akid=1697%2E1086043%2EnaPsoh)**

# Over 300,000 Electric Cut-Offs Pending Under Wes Moore.

# Wes Moore is focused on his own political power...but Maryland families need a governor who will keep their electric power on.
Dear friend, Never has the urgency of our need for your support been as clear as it is now. Wes Moore is a Democratic-Socialist-praising Democratic frontrunner to be president - but we can stop him here in Maryland with your help.

[](https://us.list-manage.com/o_qUbm8Shwh?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)

Today, _Wes Moore is building his national political profile which[AP News](https://us.list-manage.com/pZ3VqFhNE1Q?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) is reporting clearly makes him a presidential contender by becoming the Chair of the National Governor's Association (NGA),_ which he then divisively is using to publicly lie claiming current federal interference the 2026 elections before they are even held.

And he is using his new position to push for a national "service program" for youth \- which he says will "save us as a society."1

But he can't even save someone here in Maryland from losing their electricity during the hot summer months.

It's simple. Wes Moore has a governance failure problem.

And this Monday, Wes Moore is calling legislators back to Annapolis to change Maryland’s redistricting rules and steal the voices of millions of Maryland voters. To advance his national ambitions, Wes Moore wants to make Maryland an 8-0 Democrat Representation in the U.S. House of Representatives.

Meanwhile, nearly 300,000 Maryland families are facing imminent electric shutoff while also facing another proposed BGE rate increase. Where is Wes? Traveling the country campaigning while offering an offensive $12.50 in assistance to ratepayers. This electric cut-off number is up from 115,000 electric cut offs last year, 100,000 cut-offs in 2024 and similar numbers in 2023.

Wes Moore's Maryland is potentially on track to have over 500,000 electric cut-offs before the end of his term. [Help me make it his only term.](https://us.list-manage.com/zjl5Lv3BJY2?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)

I will act to bring new power plants back online immediately and lower electric bills. My plan will bring closed power plants back online, expand LNG and bring online Small Modular Reactors that can efficiently power whole cities safely. SMRs are now even being considered in Pennsylvania and elsewhere, and real opportunities in this field are developing.

When we stop Wes Moore here we save both Maryland and the United States.

This is why I am asking for and need your help. [Please donate now](https://us.list-manage.com/oj89UukIFav?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) \- any amount will help. You can also sign up to volunteer and [help us ballot chase](https://us.list-manage.com/aqqzccwzm9d?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) and win the swing votes needed to win the election.

For Maryland First,

Dan Cox
Republican Nominee for Governor of Maryland

P.S. Don't miss our [upcoming events](https://us.list-manage.com/pzIfQd0CFsW?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) as well. I'd love to see you there.

1\. Sound familiar? A school-to-work pipeline was first discussed as concerning in The Phyllis Schlafly Report, www. eagleforum.org, where Mrs. Schlafly detailed how it could create an "unholy alliance between big government and big corporations,” allowing bureaucrats to dictate national job placement.

name: Dan Osborn
subject: Why I was fired:
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY RESIST RECLAIM REBUILD PAC (WWW
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-osborn [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-osborn]
In October 2021, I had been an employee of Kellogg’s for almost 18 years.
I had dropped out of college and started working for the company after my wife got pregnant. Life’s easy when all you gotta do is take care of yourself – but we needed diapers and health insurance for our growing family.
Working at Kellogg’s used to be a lifelong career. A good-paying job that lets you become a homeowner, live decently, and hopefully retire someday.
But over the years, that changed. Workers were paid less. Cost-of-living adjustments weren’t keeping up anywhere near inflation. Retirement and health insurance plans were gutted. It just wasn’t right. They were making record profits – and doing it off the backs of workers.
So in October 2021, we walked out. And as president of our local union, I led the strike. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-osborn]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP62/1/120031/images/Screen%20Shot%202026-04-24%20at%2011.20.44%20AM.png]
Most of us had never walked a picket line. It was cold, but we were determined to hold our lines through the dead of winter if we had to. We were a part of something bigger than ourselves. We were in a fight for the future of the American middle class.
After 11 weeks in the cold, we reached an agreement. More importantly, we saved 500 good-paying union jobs.
It was one of the proudest moments of my life.
Following the strike, I was fired. Someone had to pay – and as union president, my head was on the chopping block.
It’s easy to let yourself get beaten down by life. To let big corporations and the politicians they own in Washington make all the decisions – and just accept that that’s how things will always be. But that’s not me.
Instead, I decided last year to run against one of the most corporate politicians – U.S. Senator Republican Deb Fischer – and we nearly won. I got 47% of the vote in one of the closest Senate races in the country.
Now, I’m running again for the U.S. Senate – this time against billionaire Republican Pete Ricketts – and the first poll shows us virtually TIED: 46% to 45%.
I am taking on a literal billionaire senator. We can finish what we started last year and flip Nebraska’s Senate seat for working-class people, but I need grassroots donors like you to give now if we’re going to win.
Please, will you contribute to my campaign for U.S. Senate to help me defeat billionaire Republican Pete Ricketts here and flip Nebraska’s Senate seat? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-osborn]
DONATE TODAY TO DEFEAT THE MAGA BILLIONAIRES! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-osborn]
I believe we can win this race and keep up the fight for the American middle class. But I’m counting on your support now to win.
Thank you,
Dan Osborn

Well, holy shit, my fellow Angry Democrats.
Rep. Max Miller went live this morning at 10 a.m. to beat the allegations against him, explain away the allegations made by his ex-wife, Emily Moreno, and tell everyone why he should remain in Congress.
[Get 20% off for 1 year](https://substack.com/redirect/815ac8d6-b7c9-4a8e-b46a-beda1287560f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**It did not go well.**
[](https://substack.com/redirect/5b971a1e-d20d-4f60-8e9e-574358f4ec17?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Actually, that is being generous. It was an **absolute political malpractice masterclass.** Miller released a video and a treasure trove of documents, recordings, and text messages for his political opposition to spend the next three months cutting apart.
[Max MIller Documents](https://substack.com/redirect/f2915547-7b44-47d6-b2ec-b6d671b986be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
It showed that he has absolutely no common fucking sense and no clue what the hell he is doing.
This is not going to end well for Max Miller.
And it shouldn't.
Before getting into this, I want to be clear about something: **these are allegations.** Miller denies abusing his ex-wife or daughter. He has not been convicted of these accusations, and the child-services investigation into his daughter's broken collarbone was reportedly unsubstantiated, meaning investigators did not find enough evidence to establish neglect or abuse.
Allegations are not proof. Pictures of red skin and bruising are not, by themselves, proof of how those injuries occurred.
But due diligence does not mean ignoring a pattern of accusations spanning nearly two decades. It means looking at what has been alleged, what has been documented, what Miller admits, what he denies, and whether this person is capable of representing Ohio's 7th Congressional District while his personal life is exploding all over the internet.
* * *
## These Allegations Are Nothing New
[Get 20% off for 1 year](https://substack.com/redirect/815ac8d6-b7c9-4a8e-b46a-beda1287560f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The accusations surrounding Max Miller did not begin with his divorce.
**[Politico reported in 2021 that three people said Miller pushed a girl out of his room while in high school after she resisted his attempts to touch her, causing her to fall down a flight of stairs.](https://substack.com/redirect/ace1bdc6-94ff-46d5-80ee-e886be672eca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/ace1bdc6-94ff-46d5-80ee-e886be672eca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)Miller categorically denied that happened. When Mother Jones contacted the woman years later, she called it "one of the more traumatic nights" of her life.
Former Trump White House press secretary Stephanie Grisham also accused Miller of becoming physically abusive during their relationship. According to reporting at the time, she alleged that Miller pushed her against a wall and slapped her after she confronted him about cheating.
Miller denied Grisham's accusations and sued her for defamation. The lawsuit was later dropped after the two reached a confidential settlement. Grisham has since filed another lawsuit alleging Miller violated that agreement with his more recent public comments.
Grisham also wrote that she told people around **Donald Trump** that the relationship had become abusive and that they did not seem to care. As she wrote in [The Washington Post](https://substack.com/redirect/bf6685d1-ace1-491e-a790-93290054cb2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the Trumps knew when the relationship had turned abusive and "didn't seem to care."
I reached out to Grisham myself. She told me she could not speak on the record because of the legal restrictions surrounding the case, although she did speak with me privately.
Now we have accusations from Emily Moreno, Miller's ex-wife and the daughter of Republican Sen. Bernie Moreno.
Emily has accused Miller of throwing hot water at her, shoving her into a wall, putting a loaded gun to her head, using drugs, and engaging in aggressive and demeaning behavior. Their **two-year-old daughter later suffered a broken collarbone** under circumstances neither parent could explain. Emily reportedly told police that her daughter had said, "Daddy's house is scary."
Again, Miller denies the allegations. The cause of the child's broken collarbone has not been established. Nobody should say Miller broke his daughter's collarbone as if a court has proven that he did.
But what the actual fuck are we doing here?
We now have multiple women, across different periods of Miller's life, describing accusations of aggressive or violent behavior. Due diligence does not require us to convict Miller ourselves. It does require us to ask whether this pattern is acceptable in someone serving in Congress.
* * *
## Miller's Own Water Recording Makes Him Look Worse
Miller released audio that he apparently believes clears him.
It does not.
In one recording, Emily says Miller poured steaming hot water on her. Miller does not respond by saying nothing involving water ever happened. Instead, he argues about intent, temperature, and whether the incident was playful.
> "It was never done to hurt you, and you know that."
[](https://substack.com/redirect/2f2122d2-f2e4-479a-b78e-ec1e0dd99211?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
He says the faucet could not produce boiling water and compares it to standing under a hot shower. He says he and his attorneys tested the water temperature because he anticipated that she would raise the allegation.
**Gaslighting 101!**
Miller's defense appears to just be that something involving hot water happened, it simply was not intended to hurt her.
That is not the clean denial Miller seems to believe it is.
**He calls it a "playful incident." She says it was not playful.**
The question is no longer only whether an incident happened. It is what happened, how hot the water was, why it happened, whether she was injured, and whether Miller is minimizing something serious by calling it playful.
That is not exoneration. That is a fucking evidentiary argument over the temperature of the water.
* * *
## But She Cooked Me Dinner
[Get 20% off for 1 year](https://substack.com/redirect/815ac8d6-b7c9-4a8e-b46a-beda1287560f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Another part of Miller's defense is that Emily continued interacting with him after an alleged assault.
Miller says Ring doorbell footage shows Emily leaving his home calmly with their daughter. He says she did not immediately call police or go to the hospital. He says she went to a child's birthday party, spoke with him about their daughter's medical procedure, offered to cook him empanadas six days later, invited him and his girlfriend to a playground, and wrote that they were in a "friendlier place."
Then he asks:
> "If I had assaulted her, would she have offered to cook me dinner six days later?"
I do not know, Max. Maybe.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/8be02672-ccba-4e7c-8be6-aea443f475fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
People remain in contact with former partners after alleged abuse all the time, especially when they share custody of a two-year-old child. People act normally because they are scared, confused, trying to de-escalate a situation, trying to co-parent, or trying to keep their lives from completely exploding.
Her making empanadas does not prove an assault happened. It also does not prove that one did not happen.
The fact that Emily cooked dinner six days later is not the Perry Mason moment Max thinks it is.
**" What do you mean I assaulted her? She made me empanadas."**
What the fuck does that have to do with anything?
* * *
## Then There Are the Needles
[Get 20% off for 1 year](https://substack.com/redirect/815ac8d6-b7c9-4a8e-b46a-beda1287560f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Miller also released an audio recording involving allegations of drug use.
In the recording, Emily says she went into his backpack because she believed he had a drug problem. She says it began with weed and that she later found needles near his bed or in a bedroom drawer.
Miller denies that the needles belonged to him. He repeatedly says he has never had needles in his bedroom drawer and offers to be tested for drugs.
That is his denial, and it should be included.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/7f7591ec-5cf6-4943-9daf-d39846933b75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
But the recording does not establish whose needles they were, whether the photograph Emily says she took exists, or whether Miller was using injectable drugs. It captures one person making an allegation and Miller denying it.
Once again, releasing it publicly does not resolve anything. It simply gives voters another disturbing argument between a congressman and his former wife to listen to on the internet.
Max apparently looked at this recording and thought, "Yes, this will help."
Political malpractice.
* * *
## Bernie Moreno Finally Found His Balls
For years, **SENATOR** Bernie Moreno remained publicly silent while allegations involving his daughter and former son-in-law continued piling up.
When I was running for Congress in 2024, I wondered whether Bernie would eventually throw Miller under the bus.
He did not.
Why?
Because Bernie Moreno was a complete fucking wuss.
But after watching Miller's unhinged livestream, Bernie finally found his balls.
Maybe they (his balls) were at the house of whoever created that old Adult Friend Finder profile using his work email. The Associated Press confirmed that somebody with access to Moreno's account created a profile seeking encounters with men. And by encounters I mean sex. And by with men, I mean Bernie Moreno having sex with men. Moreno's lawyer said an intern created it as a prank, and [the AP could not independently determine who actually made it](https://substack.com/redirect/e7b2705a-5c4a-4c29-9588-ca31172e8dcd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Fine. Maybe it was the intern. Maybe it was Bernie. Maybe it was Batman.
I do not care.
And Bernie, let me extend an olive branch here: **Democrats do not care if somebody is gay, straight, bisexual, or anything else. Nobody is going to burn in hell for rubbing another man 's Johnson.**
What I care about is that it took you this long to speak publicly while your daughter was making allegations this serious.
After Miller's livestream, Moreno released a blistering statement saying the past two years had been "pure hell" for his family. He accused Miller of "increasingly erratic and dangerous behavior," said Miller needs "serious psychological help," called him a danger to his daughter, and said he holds his breath whenever Miller has custody of his granddaughter.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f14b3337-a999-426a-81a0-cbb139e1715e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Moreno concluded:
> "If there are any basic standards of character required to hold elected office, Max Miller fails them. He should not serve in the House of Representatives."
Bernie Moreno is not some liberal activist. He is a Republican senator, a Trump ally, Miller's former father-in-law, and the grandfather of the child at the center of this nightmare. [He is now publicly calling on Miller to leave Congress](https://substack.com/redirect/d39668a9-69bd-4cd4-a9b3-052d469fa923?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
That does not legally prove Emily's allegations.
**But holy shit, it should get everyone 's attention.**
* * *
## Republicans Are Politically Insane if They Keep Him
[Get 20% off for 1 year](https://substack.com/redirect/815ac8d6-b7c9-4a8e-b46a-beda1287560f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
If Donald Trump and Republican leaders do not call for Miller's immediate resignation, **then they are either completely abhorrent in what they are willing to tolerate or too politically stupid to understand what is happening.**
Maybe both.
A Republican-commissioned poll conducted July 29 and 30 reportedly showed Democratic challenger Brian Poindexter leading Miller 44 percent to 39 percent, with 16 percent unsure. Miller's favorability was reportedly just 25 percent, while 41 percent viewed him unfavorably.
Yes, that is Republican polling.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/530e793e-070d-41b7-8ade-52fdd06f1b6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A previous Democratic internal poll had Miller leading by only one point, 44 percent to 43 percent. That was already a statistical tie in a district Trump won by double digits in 2024.
**Now the Republican poll has Max losing by five.**
**What a crash and burn.**
For comparison, Miller's favorability in that Republican poll is significantly worse than Trump's approval in the district. Max Miller has somehow managed to become less popular than Donald Trump in a Republican-leaning district.
That takes work. Real hard work. _I said "hard"... calm down Senator Moreno_
From a purely partisan Democratic perspective, we should want Max to remain in the race. Keep him right there. Put him on every television station. Let him keep releasing recordings. Let him hold another livestream. Maybe next time he can bring a whiteboard and diagram the exact temperature of his kitchen faucet.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f6e9b02e-4cdf-41f2-a74b-fe32d7bd4a03?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**This is a flippable district. Always has been.**
But from the standpoint of responsible government, basic ethics, and the dignity of Congress, Miller should have been gone yesterday.
Republicans still have an opportunity to replace him with a normal Republican who could probably retain the seat. If Trump cares about keeping control of the House, this should be a simple political decision.
Call Max and tell him to get the fuck out.

## Max Miller Has Barely Represented Us Anyway
[Get 20% off for 1 year](https://substack.com/redirect/815ac8d6-b7c9-4a8e-b46a-beda1287560f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
These allegations and the legal battles surrounding them are now an enormous distraction.
Miller is fighting his ex-wife, his former father-in-law, Stephanie Grisham, attorneys, reporters, political opponents, and apparently anyone else who walks within ten feet of an Ohio courthouse.
I do not believe anyone can be fully focused on legislation, constituents, and the geopolitical disaster unfolding around us while doing all of that.
To be perfectly honest, I have been criticizing Miller for barely showing up for constituents long before this.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/5aaffff2-1cc0-44c3-abe8-7d40ed2f242f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
He has avoided traditional town halls. He has often blamed security concerns and antisemitism, which is absolutely on the rise and should be taken seriously. But he also seems terrified of standing in front of ordinary Republicans, Democrats, and independents and answering for his record.
We see him occasionally at a homecoming festival or community event when reelection comes around. Spotting Max Miller in the district is like Punxsutawney Phil seeing his shadow.
He crawls out of his hole, sees his shadow, shakes a few hands, and announces two more years of elected office.
Then he disappears again.
Now he is even more distracted. Instead of discussing legislation, healthcare, inflation, war, immigration, the economy, or what he has actually accomplished, he is publicly arguing that his faucet does not get hot enough to burn someone.
This is not representation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/86ccd40f-5d60-46ee-b3fb-57c20ec5f0d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

## Think About the Child
There is also a two-year-old girl trapped in the middle of all of this.
Nobody wants to grow up knowing the entire internet can search for recordings, allegations, photographs, police reports, court documents, and public accusations about their parents.
**That shit never disappears.**
Miller says he is defending himself. Emily says she is protecting herself and her daughter. Bernie says he is speaking out because he fears for his family.
**Whatever the adults believe they are accomplishing, the child will eventually inherit every ugly piece of it.**
By making this as public as it has become, there is almost no way for this to be healthy for her later.
That alone should cause everyone involved to step back and ask what the fuck they are doing.

## Go Be Rich, Max
[Get 20% off for 1 year](https://substack.com/redirect/815ac8d6-b7c9-4a8e-b46a-beda1287560f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Max Miller needs to resign.
Not because it is the politically best outcome for Democrats. It is not. The politically best outcome for Democrats is for Max to remain on the ballot, keep imploding, and hand Brian Poindexter a Republican district.
He should resign because it is the right thing for Congress, the district, the country, and his daughter.
And as [D.J. Byrnes](https://open.substack.com/users/737165-dj-byrnes?utm_source=mentions) The Rooster says, **Just Go be rich, Max.**
Seriously.
One current estimate places Miller's net worth at roughly **$12 million.** He has trusts, investments, and valuable property. He does not need this job.
